Seven Employees, Five Of Whom High Officials, 
Being Investigated By Police Regarding 
$50,000 Robbery On Thursday Morning 


While Uity Government authori- 
ties were investigating seven em- 
ployees of the Nantao District 
Court ir connection with the $50,- 
000 robbery on Thursday morning 
Mr. Nee Sze-ching wes formally 
inducted in the office of President 


of the Court at 10 a.m. yesterday. 


Mr. Nien Lun-kwei, his predeces- 
sor, had been previously dismissed 
from the same office by an order 
received from the Ministry of Jus- 
tice in Nanking. Till late yester- 
day, he and the six other suspects 
were being held for interrogation. 


Five of those arrested, it was 
revealed, were high officials of the 
Court, namely, Mr Nien Lun- 
kwei, President: Mr. Loh Chi, 
Chief of the Criminal Section; Mr. 
Chiang Pan-nien, Procurator; Mr. 
Liu Chin, Chief Secretary: Mr. Chi 


Tso, Chief Clerk, and Mr. Chiao 
Sze-yee, Chief of Section. 
In view of the fact that these 


men had been removed trom their 
respective positions for undisclosed 
reasons several days before the 
robbery took place, they are sus- 
pected of having planned and per- 
petrated the crime. 


Four Men Enter Premises 


In the early morning of last 
Thursday, a gang of four robbers, 
armed with kitchen knives, broke 
into the premises of the Nantao 


District Court and removed money 
and various valuables from the: 
sate, valued at about $50,000. 
Among the loot were $6,000 in 
silver coins, valued in the market 
at $15,000, if converted into local 
currency. Al considerable quantity 
of opium was also reported to 
have been stolen. 


Accerding to the assistant vault- 
keeper, named Ying Sze-zen, at 
about 1 a.m. on Thursday, the 
quartette broke into his sleeping 
quarters and immediately gagged 
him with cotton. After tying him 
up, with his hands bound together 
at the back, he was left alone on! 
the verandah, he stated. Ying was 
found by other Court employees at 
about 7.30 a.m. of the same day. 

Subsequent investigations reveal- 
ed, however, that there were no 
clues that could be found on the 
premises indicating that four armed 
robbers had entered the premises. 
No foctprints or fingerprints were 
found in the room, it was ppinted 
out. Doubting his version of the 
robbery, the City Government Police 
detained Ying. > 


On personal guarantee offered by 
the Chief of the Court Guards, 
Chen Foo, Ying was later released. 
In the course of the inquiry, hcws 
ever, he disappeared, whereupon 
Chen Foo was also taken. into cus- 
tody on suspicion of complicity.

SUBJECT: Proposed enforcement in Nantao of a system

number of persons

In view of the serious problem of food
supplies in this city, Mr. Woo Shih-ngoo ( 胡澤吾 ),
Commissioner of the Shanghai Special Municipality
Foodstuffs Control Bureau ( 上海特別市糧食管局 ),
No. 50 Ih Soh Ke ( 一粟街 ), Boon Lai Road, Nantao,
has proposed to enforce, first in Nantao area, a system
of allocation of food to residents according to the
number of persons.

Since March 1, the Nantao No. 1 "Faung"
Guild ( 南市第一坊公所 ), No. 267 Boon Lai Road,
has undertaken the registration of applications by
residents in the No. 1 "Faung " for allocation of food
according to the number of persons. The residents are
required to produce residential certificates and furnish
proper guarantee when filling in the application forms,
which promise the purchase by every resident of ½ shun

residents and returned to the "Faung" Guild, these forms

necessary arrangements, after which certificates will
be issued for the purchase of rice according to the
number of persons.

that the procedure will be completed within a short
period of time. Hence, the Foodstuffs Control Bureau
has continued to undertake the cheap sale of rice.

鉴于本市粮食供应问题的严重性，上海特别市粮食管理局（地址：南市蓬莱路一粟街50号）局长胡泽吾先生（Woo Shih-ngoo）提议，首先在南市地区实施一项按居民人数分配粮食的制度。

自3月1日起，位于蓬莱路267号的南市第一坊公所已开始受理第一坊居民按人数申请配粮的登记。居民在填写申请表时，须出示居住证明并提供适当担保，承诺每位居民每日购买半升大米。表格由居民填写并交回坊公所以后，将转送粮食管理局进行必要安排，随后将签发按人数购米的凭证。

由于程序复杂，预计无法在短时间内完成。因此，粮食管理局继续开展大米平价销售工作。每户凭居住证明，可在指定的米店以每升1.70元的价格购买5升大米。

June 17, 1941.

President and Chief Procurator of Shanghai District
Court, Nantao, dismissed for Corrupt Practice.
Five Court Officials arrested on suspicion of Larceny.

Nyien Lun Kuei (嚴倫魁) and Tsung Fong
(曹春舫), President and Chief Procurator respectively of
the Shanghai District Court on Been Lai Road, Nantao, were
both dismissed from their posts on May 31, 1941. It is
learned that this was the result of a complaint made by
people with strong evidence to the Kiangsu High Court of the
Nanking regime against the two officials concerned for
corrupt practice. Sun Chao (孫昭) was therefore
appointed by the Kiangsu High Court as Acting President of
the Shanghai District Court.

On June 11, 1941, it was discovered in the Court
in question that a large quantity of stolen properties, valued
at about $30,000.00, had been stolen. Investigations were
conducted by the Acting President of the Court and it was
ascertained that the larceny was perpetrated with the
connivance of some officials of the Court. As a result,
Ich Chi (陸起), Presiding Judge of the Criminal Division
of the Court, Tsaung Pan Nien (莊彭年), a Procurator,
Liu Jin (刘勤), a Clerk, Chi Chao (稽超), the Chief
Clerk, and Zao Sze Nyi (趙思義), Chief Process Server,
were arrested and taken to the City Government Police Bureau
for interrogation. Nyien Lun Kuei, the relieved President,
has also been placed under detention in the Court premises.

The Ministry of Justice of the Nanking Government
has recently appointed one Nyi Sze Ching (倪世清) as
President of the Shanghai District Court. He formally took
over office on June 14, and will start a reshuffle of the
personnel of the Court and an investigation of the irregularities.

1941年6月17日。

上海地方法院（南市）院长及首席检察官因贪污行为被免职。
五名法院官员因涉嫌盗窃罪被捕。

严伦魁（Nyien Lun Kuei）和曹春舫（Tsung Fong），分别为位于南市蓬莱路的上海地方法院院长和首席检察官，均于1941年5月31日被免职。据悉，这是有人向南京伪政权江苏高等法院投诉这两名官员贪污行为并提供有力证据的结果。因此，孙昭（Sun Chao）被江苏高等法院任命为上海地方法院代理院长。

1941年6月11日，在该法院发现大量被盗财物，价值约30,000.00美元。经法院代理院长调查，查明该盗窃案是在法院某些官员的纵容下实施的。结果，该院刑事庭庭长陆起（Ich Chi）、检察官庄彭年（Tsaung Pan Nien）、书记员刘勤（Liu Jin）、主任书记官稽超（Chi Chao）以及首席传票送达员赵思义（Zao Sze Nyi）被捕，并被带往市政府警察局接受审讯。已被免职的院长严伦魁也被拘禁在法院内。

南京政府司法部最近任命倪世清（Nyi Sze Ching）为上海地方法院院长。他于6月14日正式就职，并将开始对法院人员进行改组并对违规行为进行调查。

New President Of Nantao's
High Court Installed

Seven Employees, Five Of Whom High Officials,
Being Investigated By Police Regarding
$50,000 Robbery On Thursday Morning

While City Government authorities were investigating seven employees of the Nantao District Court in connection with the $50,-000 robbery on Thursday morning Mr. Nee Sze-ching was formally inducted in the office of President of the Court at 10 a.m. yesterday.

Mr. Nien Lun-kwei, his predecessor, had been previously dismissed from the same office by an order received from the Ministry of Justice in Nanking. Till late yesterday, he and the six other suspects were being held for interrogation.

Five of those arrested, it was revealed, were high officials of the Court, namely, Mr. Nien Lun-kwei, President: Mr. Loh Chi, Chief of the Criminal Section; Mr. Chiang Pan-nien, Procurator; Mr. Liu Chin, Chief Secretary: Mr. Chi Tso, Chief Clerk, and Mr. Chiao Sze-yee, Chief of Section.

In view of the fact that these men had been removed from their respective positions for undisclosed reasons several days before the robbery took place, they are suspected of having planned and perpetrated the crime.

Four Men Enter Premises

In the early morning of last Thursday, a gang of four robbers, armed with kitchen knives, broke into the premises of the Nantao District Court and removed money and various valuables from the safe, valued at about $50,000. Among the loot were $6,000 in silver coins, valued in the market at $15,000, if converted into local currency. A considerable quantity of opium was also reported to have been stolen.

According to the assistant vault-keeper, named Ying Sze-zen, at about 1 a.m. on Thursday, the quartette broke into his sleeping quarters and immediately gagged him with cotton. After tying him up, with his hands bound together at the back, he was left alone on the verandah, he stated. Ying was found by other Court employees at about 7.30 a.m. of the same day.

Subsequent investigations revealed, however, that there were no clues that could be found on the premises indicating that four armed robbers had entered the premises. No footprints or fingerprints were found in the room, it was pointed out. Doubting his version of the robbery, the City Government Police detained Ying.

On personal guarantee offered by the Chief of the Court Guards, Chen Foo, Ying was later released. In the course of the inquiry, however, he disappeared, whereupon Chen Foo was also taken into custody on suspicion of complicity.
pages.zh:
南市高等法院新院长就职

七名雇员，其中五名为高官，正就周四早晨发生的5万美元抢劫案接受警方调查

当市政府当局正在调查南市地方法院七名雇员与周四早晨发生的5万美元抢劫案的关系时，倪世清先生于昨天上午10时正式接任法院院长一职。

他的前任严伦魁先生此前已接到南京司法部命令，被免去同一职务。直到昨天深夜，他和其他六名嫌疑人仍被扣留接受审讯。

据透露，被捕者中有五人是法院的高级官员，即：院长严伦魁先生；刑事科科长陆起（Loh Chi）先生；检察官蒋彭年（Chiang Pan-nien）先生；主任秘书刘勤（Liu Chin）先生；主任书记官稽佐（Chi Tso）先生，以及科长赵思义（Chiao Sze-yee）先生。

鉴于这几人在抢劫案发生前几天已因未公开的原因被解除各自职务，他们被怀疑策划并实施了该犯罪。

四人进入院内

上周四清晨，一伙四名手持菜刀的劫匪闯入南市地方法院大院，从保险箱中窃走现金及各种贵重物品，价值约5万美元。赃物中包括价值6,000美元的银币，若兑换成当地货币，市场价值为15,000美元。据报道，还有相当数量的鸦片被盗。

据名为应思珍（Ying Sze-zen）的助理金库管理员称，周四凌晨1点左右，这四名歹徒闯入他的卧室，立即用棉花堵住他的嘴。他说，将他双手反绑后，他被独自留在走廊上。当天早上7点30分左右，其他法院员工发现了应某。

然而，随后的调查显示，在现场没有发现任何表明有四名武装劫匪进入的迹象。有人指出，房间内没有发现脚印或指纹。由于怀疑他对抢劫案的描述，市政府警察拘留了应某。

在法院警卫队长陈福（Chen Foo）提供个人担保后，应某后来获释。然而，在调查过程中，他失踪了，于是陈福也因涉嫌共犯而被拘留。

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS
15 1941

Seven Officials Held
For Court Robbery

It was reported in the Chinese
papers yesterday that seven officials
of the Shanghai District Court in
Nantao had been arrested by the
authorities in connection with the
robbery on Thursday, when approxi-
mately $50,000 in cash and property
were stolen.
The first two persons to be de-
tained were stated to be Chang Sung-
min and Ying Sz-chen, both of them
responsible for the stolen property
store. The latter, however, managed
to persuade a court policeman to
allow him to go home to regulate
his family affairs and absconded. The
officer was then detained.
On Friday, the Nantao Police
Branch Bureau arrested Loh Chi, dis-
charged chief of the Criminal Divi-
sion of the Court, Chang Bang-nyien,
procurator, Liu Jing, chief clerk, and
two other court officials. They are
suspected of taking part in the rob-
bery and have been sent to the Police
Bureau at the Civic Centre for ques-
tioning.

《字林西报》
1941年5月15日

七名官员因法院抢劫案被捕

据中文报纸昨日报道，南市上海地方法院的七名官员因涉嫌周四发生的抢劫案被当局逮捕，当时约有五万美元现金及财物被盗。

据悉，最先被拘留的两人是张松民（Chang Sung-min，音译）和应思贞（Ying Sz-chen，音译），二人均负责保管赃物仓库。然而，后者设法说服一名法院法警允许其回家处理家务，随后潜逃。该法警随即被拘留。

周五，南市警察分局逮捕了已被免职的法院刑事庭庭长罗奇（Loh Chi，音译）、检察官张邦年（Chang Bang-nyien，音译）、首席书记员刘静（Liu Jing，音译）以及另外两名法院官员。他们涉嫌参与抢劫，已被送往市中心警察局接受讯问。

Unauthorized Functioning of Nantao District
Court employee in the Settlement.

S.S.

received from C.P.C.159 to the effect that an official
of the Nantao District Court had requested assistance
from him to arrest the proprietor of a shop No.134,
North Taren Road, and explained that he (C.P.C.) was
with the official near to that address.

D.S.J. Yo Yuen Loong and C.D.C.158 immediately
proceeded to No.134, North Taren Road, which is the
Yoong Mao Sang (永茂盛) small porcelain shop and
therein found:-

(1) The said shop proprietor named Sz E Sung
(史益生), age 60, married, Native of
Neeching, living in the premises.

(2) Lee Jung Tsao (邵慎初), age 40, native of
Chingkiang, ex-process server in the Nantao
District Court and residing in Nantao. He
was in possession of an identification
badge of the said court.

(3) Hsia Yie Zung (谢元诚), age 37, native of
Shanghai, warrant collector, residing at
585, Rue Lafayette, French Concession.

shop when the said detectives arrived.

The 1st, 2nd and 3rd described were brought to
the station with the C.P.C.

1941年5月14日

南市地方法院雇员在租界内非法执行职务。

S.S.

本月13日下午6时41分，接到来自第159号中国巡捕（C.P.C.）的电话报告，称一名南市地方法院官员请求其协助逮捕塔伦路（Taren Road，音译）北段134号一家店铺的店主，并解释说他（该中国巡捕）正与该官员一同在该地址附近。

副探长姚元龙（Yo Yuen Loong，音译）和第158号华人侦探（C.D.C.）立即前往塔伦路北段134号，即永茂盛小瓷器店，并在店内发现：

(1) 该店店主史益生（Sz E Sung），60岁，已婚，籍贯宁波，居住于店内。

(2) 邵慎初（Lee Jung Tsao），40岁，籍贯镇江，前南市地方法院传票送达员，居住于南市。他持有该法院的身份徽章。

(3) 谢元诚（Hsia Yie Zung），37岁，籍贯上海，收租人，居住于法租界霞飞路585号。

当上述侦探到达时，第3129号中国巡捕正站在店铺前门外。

上述第1、2、3项所述人员随同该中国巡捕被带至警局。

pages.en:
1/2

Enquiries by D.S.I. MacLennan, D.S.I. Yao and
C.D.C.158 revealed as follows:-
The above shop proprietor Sz E Sung (1st
described) formerly occupied the Vai Tsang (萬昌)
porcelain shop, No.729, Rue Bayle, French Concession,
for four years, the rent for which shop ($40.00 per
month) he paid to Hsia Yue Zung (3rd described). In
February 1941, Sz E Sung(1st described) was $440.00
in arrears of rent and was unable to pay same to Hsia
Yue Zung (3rd described). Consequently, in February,
1940, Hsia Yue Zung filed a suit in the 2nd S.S.D.
Court for the eviction of Sz E Sung from the shop and
for the recovery of the rent due, ie. $440.00. Several
days later Sz E Sung appeared at the 2nd S.S.D. Court
on Summons, when the case came up for hearing and was
ordered to evacuate the premises, No.729, Rue Bayle, on
or before 10/3/40. He was further ordered by the Court
to pay $40.00 per month to Hsia Yue Zung (谢元诚) for
eleven months as from February 1940 and so liquidate
the arrears. In consequence of this court order Sz E
Sung vacated the shop, No.729, Rue Bayle, at the end
of February 1940 and has since occupied his shop at
present address, No.124, North Honan Road, which is
within the limits of the Japanese Defence Sector.
pages.zh:
1/2

经副督察麦肯纳（MacLennan）、副督察姚（Yao）和第158号华人侦探调查，情况如下：

上述店主史益生（第1项所述）此前曾在法租界贝勒路729号经营万昌瓷器店四年，该店租金（每月40.00美元）支付给谢岳宗（Hsia Yue Zung，即第3项所述之人）。1941年2月，史益生（第1项所述）拖欠租金440.00美元，无力向谢岳宗（第3项所述）支付。因此，1940年2月，谢岳宗向第二特区地方法院提起诉讼，要求将史益生逐出店铺并追缴欠租，即440.00美元。数日后，史益生接到传票出庭应诉，案件开庭审理后，法院命令其在1940年3月10日或之前腾空贝勒路729号的房屋。法院还命令他自1940年2月起，连续十一个月每月向谢元诚（Hsia Yue Zung）支付40.00美元，以清偿欠款。鉴于此法院命令，史益生于1940年2月底腾退了贝勒路729号的店铺，此后一直占用其现址河南路北段124号的店铺，该地址位于日本防卫区范围内。

pages.en:
1/3

After the above ruling had been rendered by
the 2nd S.S.D. Court Sz E Sung, although having
evacuated the shop at 729, Rue Bayle, failed to pay
the monthly amount of $40.00 to Hsia Yue Zung and
consequently three or four summonses were sent by
the 2nd S.S.D. Court to Sz E Sung during 1940,
ordering him to appear at the 2nd S.S.D. Court. These
summonses were not forwarded direct to Sz E Sung but
were sent to his friend named "Sung", proprietor of
the Mei Dee (萬利) Coal shop, 725, Rue Bayle, who,
in turn, handed them to Sz E Sung (史益生) who
ignored them.

After the 2nd S.S.D. Court had been taken
over by the Nanking Regime, this case was handed over
to the Nantao District Court to whom Hsia Yue Zung
(謝文誠) then appealed for action in connection
with the arrears of rent. Subsequently, on 3/2/1941,
the Nantao Court sent a Summons to Sz E Sung, though
his friend at 725, Rue Bayle, ordering him to appear
at the Nantao Court on 6/2/41. Sz E Sung ignored
this Summons.

Consequently at 4.20 p.m.14/5/41, the Nantao
Court process server Zau Zung Tsoo (邵慎初), armed
with a warrant, No.76, issued by the Nantao Court
for the arrest of Sz E Sung, for non-payment of the
pages.zh:
1/3

在第二特区地方法院作出上述裁决后，史益生虽然已腾空贝勒路729号的店铺，但未向谢岳宗支付每月40.00美元的款项，因此第二特区地方法院在1940年间向史益生发出了三四次传票，命令其到第二特区地方法院出庭。这些传票并未直接发送给史益生，而是寄给了他在贝勒路725号万利煤店的朋友“宋”（Sung，音译），后者又将传票转交给史益生（史益生），但史益生对此置之不理。

在第二特区地方法院被南京政权接管后，此案移交给南市地方法院，谢岳宗（谢文诚）随后向该院上诉，要求就欠租问题采取行动。随后，南市法院于1941年2月3日向史益生发出传票，虽是通过他在贝勒路725号的朋友转交，命令其于1941年2月6日到南市法院出庭。史益生无视此传票。

因此，1941年5月14日下午4时20分，南市法院传票送达员赵宗佐（Zau Zung Tsoo，即邵慎初）手持南市法院签发的第76号逮捕令，因史益生未支付

pages.en:
1/4

rent arrears, arrived in a hire motor car at 124,
North Honan Road, accompanied by the rent collector
Hsia Yue Zung. Both of them called C.P.C.3129 who was
on post duty nearby and, producing the warrant, the
process server asked the C.P.C. if he could execute
it. The C.P.C., after learning that the process server
had not requested assistance from West Hongkew Station,
telephoned this station from a nearby shop with the
result that detectives attended and brought the case
to the station.

On instructions from D.C. "Crime" it was
emphasized to the process server that he had no
authority, whatever, to function in the Settlement
and that Sz E Sung could not be handed over to him.
After being warned against a repetition of the case
he was allowed to go with the rent collector at 8 p.m.
14/5/41. The shop-proprietor Sz E Sung was allowed to
leave this station at 8.15 p.m. 14/5/41. He, in the
station, admitted owing the $440.00 rent arrears and
stated that it was his intention to pay same to the
rent collector on an early date.

Ja Kennedy.
15: 5: 41.
Sen. Det. 1/c.

D. S. I.

D.D.O."C".
pages.zh:
1/4

欠租而前来逮捕他，乘坐一辆租赁汽车抵达河南北路124号，收租人谢岳宗随行。二人叫住了 nearby 执勤的第3129号中国巡捕，送达员出示逮捕令后，询问该中国巡捕是否可以执行。该中国巡捕得知送达员未向西虹口巡捕房请求协助后，从附近一家商店打电话至本巡捕房，结果侦探赶到并将此案带回警局。

根据“刑事”副总监的指示，向送达员强调他无权在租界内执行任何职务，且史益生不能被移交给她。在警告其不得重犯后，允许他与收租人于1941年5月14日晚8时离开。店主史益生于1941年5月14日晚8时15分获准离开本巡捕房。他在警局内承认拖欠租金440.00美元，并表示打算尽早向收租人支付此款。

Ja Kennedy.
1941年5月15日.

April 12th, 41.

1.

Illegal Functioning
Suspected Abduction.

At 12.30 p.m. 12-4-41, a male Chinese named Waung
Yi (王 炎) residing 212 N. Kiangse Road, came to the
station and reported that there were two male Chinese,
name etc., unknown, representing themselves to be members
of the Nantao District Court Police were attempting to
abduct a male Chinese named,
Dr. Cohen Sun (孫 國 安) of 297/3 Miller Road.
Enquiries by C.D.C. 618 and the undersigned learned
that for the past several months the landlady of Dr.
Chhen Sun named, Tsah Zung Sz (蔡 陳 氏) had attempted
to force him to remove from his residence which he
refused to do.
The landlady later cut off his electricity so he
could no longer use the electric light. The Dr. still
refused to move.
During February, approximately two months before
the receipt of this report to this station, Tsah Zung Sz
(蔡 陳 氏) made a report to the Nantao Court accusing
Dr. Cohen Sun of misappropriating the rents of the premise
in which they hired at 297/3 Miller Road.
At about 11.30 a.m. 12-4-41, the landlady appeared
at the residence together with two male Chinese who
represented themselves to be Nantao Court Police and
stated they were arresting the Dr. to answer the charges

上海公共租界工部局警务处

虹口
1941年4月12日.

1.

非法执行职务
涉嫌绑架.

1941年4月12日中午12时30分，一名居住在江西路北段212号的中国男子王炎（Waung Yi）来到警局报案，称有两名身份不明的中国男子自称是南市地方法院警察，正试图绑架居住在密勒路297/3号的孙国安博士（Dr. Cohen Sun）。经第618号华人侦探及具名人调查得知，在过去几个月里，孙陈氏（Tsah Zung Sz，孙博士的房东）曾试图强迫他搬离住所，但他拒绝照办。
房东后来切断了他的电源，使他无法使用电灯。孙博士仍拒绝搬迁。
大约在收到本报告两个月前的二月期间，孙陈氏（蔡陈氏）向南市法院举报，指控孙科恩博士挪用他们在密勒路297/3号租赁房屋的租金。
1941年4月12日上午11时30分左右，房东与两名自称是南市法院警察的中国男子一同出现在住所，声称要逮捕孙博士以回应指控

pages.en:
1/2.

in the Nantao Court. The informant Waung Yi (王炎),
being a friend of Dr. Sohan Lun (孫國安) believing the
Dr. was being abducted for the purpose of intimidating
him into moving from the premises he occupies, made a
report to this station.
An immediate visit to the scene by D.S. Kume, C.D.C.
318 and the undersigned ascertained the Dr. to have been
taken away by 4 or 5 male Chinese in private m/car licence
No. 2139.
It was learned from the wife of the abducted man,
Sun Sun iz (孫沈氏) that the male Chinese did not
identify themselves, but one of them carried a paper in
his hand which he stated was a warrant, however he did
not show it.
After enquiries in the vicinity, private m/car 2139
was located at the "Shanghai Garage" 57 Hanbury Road.
From the driver a Korean Japanese subject, An Tei Shaku
(安貞植) S.M.C. driving permit No. 23452, it was learned
that at about 11.30 a.m. 12-4-41, the m/car was hired by
a male Chinese who went to Lane 297 Miller Road which he
entered.
After a short wait 5 Chinese came out together and
entered the car and were driven to Nantao where $26.00
as fare was paid.
At 7.40 p.m. 12-4-41, C.D.C. 284 and the undersigned
pages.zh:
1/2.

在南市法院出庭。报案人王炎（王炎）是孙国伦（Sohan Lun，即孙国安）的朋友，他认为孙博士被绑架是为了恐吓他搬离所占用的房屋，遂向本警局报案。
副探长久米（Kume）、第318号华人侦探及具名人立即前往现场，查明孙博士已被四或五名中国男子带走，乘坐私家车，车牌号2139。
据被绑架者的妻子孙沈氏（Sun Sun iz）称，这些中国男子并未表明身份，但其中一人手中拿着一张纸，声称是逮捕令，但未出示。
经在附近查询，在汉伯里路57号“上海车行”找到了车牌号为2139的私家车。据司机、朝鲜籍日本人安贞植（An Tei Shaku），工部局驾驶执照号23452称，1941年4月12日上午11时30分左右，一名中国男子雇用了该车，前往密勒路297弄并进入其中。
稍作等待后，五名中国人一起出来进入车内，被载往南市，支付了26.00美元车费。
1941年4月12日晚上7时40分，第284号华人侦探及具名人

pages.en:
1/3.

made a further visit to 297/3 Miller Road and arrested
and brought to the station the chief tenant Tsah Zung
Sz (蔡東化), Canton, 52, m/female, and a male Chinese
named,
Ts Hai Zee (米海錢) 47, Soochow, m/painter, of
the same address.
Interrogated, Tsah Zung Sz admitted hiring a m/car
from the "Shanghai Garage" and with the assistance of
the above male Chinese and two male Chinese names etc.,
unknown, employees of the Nantao Court, in which
capacity unknown, they forced Dr. Cohen Sun to go to
Nantao where he was detained by the Court.
In view of the above, it being suspected that Tsah
Zung Sz and Ts Hai Zee are concerned in the abduction
of the above named male Chinese, they will be arraigned
before the S.S.D. Court, a.m. of the 15-4-41, when their
detention of one week will be requested to enable further
enquiries to be made.

Sen. Det. 1/c.

D.D.U. " C ".
pages.zh:
1/3.

再次前往密勒路297/3号，逮捕了主要租户蔡东化（Tsah Zung Sz，原文此处名字与上文蔡陈氏略有不同，依原文译），广东人，52岁，男/女（原文如此），以及同住该址的中国男子米海钱（Ts Hai Zee），47岁，苏州人，油漆工。
经讯问，蔡东化承认从“上海车行”雇用了一辆私家车，并在上述中国男子及两名身份不明的南市法院雇员（职位不明）的协助下，强迫孙科恩博士前往南市，在那里他被法院扣留。
鉴于上述情况，怀疑蔡东化和米海钱参与绑架上述中国男子，他们将于1941年4月15日上午在第二特区地方法院受审，届时将申请拘留他们一周以便进一步调查。

March 30, 1941.

NYI LUN KWEI (嚴掄魁), President of the Shanghai
District Court at Nantao - attempted assassination.
----------------------------------------------------

At 3.45 p.m., March 29, three unknown .
persons fired at a motorcar passing in the
vicinity of the corner of Chung Hwa and Wen
Miao Roads, Nantao. Nyi Lun Kwei, President
of the Shanghai District Court at Nantao, was
riding in the car but he escaped uninjured.
Immediately after the incident, the Japanese

At about 3 p.m. as Nyien Lun-kwei

closed the iron gates along the Concession border to

RUSSIAN EMIGRANTS COMMITTEE RECEIVES
ORDER CONFIRMING TRANSFER OF JURISDIC-
TION OVER RUSSIAN EMIGRANTS TO NANTAO
COURTS.

Yesterday Mr. A.M. IVANOFF, Chairman of the Russian
Emigrants Committee, received from Mr. SOO SIH-WEN, Acting May-
or of the Greater Shanghai, an order confirming the instruc-
tions issued by the late Mayor FU SIAO-I regarding the
transfer of jurisdiction over Russian emigrants in Shanghai
to the Chinese Court in Nantao.

Based on a decision of the Nanking Government
which has just been received by the Greater Shanghai Autho-
rities, the new order is the result of enquiries made by the
local authorities regarding the question of jurisdiction
over Russian emigrants in Shanghai and finally decides this
question in the sense that Russian emigrants are subject to
jurisdiction of the courts functioning in Nantao.

Interviewed in connection with this matter by a
representative of the "Far Eastern Times" Mr. IVANOFF stated
that the order in question is now being translated into the
Russian language, after which it will be published in the lo-
cal Russian newspapers. 'At present - Mr. IVANOFF continued -
I only can say that this order forbids Russian emigrants to
apply to the 1st and 2nd S.S.D. Courts. The order is of a
great importance for Russian emigrants, as, being loyal to the
country which has extended her hospitality to us, we must car-
ry out orders of the Nanking Government".

A special meeting of the Emigrants Committee will
be held to-day in connection with this matter.

俄侨委员会收到确认将俄侨管辖权移交给南市法院的命令

昨日，俄侨委员会主席伊万诺夫（A.M. IVANOFF）先生收到大上海代理市长苏希文（SOO SIH-WEN）先生的一项命令，确认已故市长傅筱庵（FU SIAO-I）此前发布的关于将在沪俄侨管辖权移交给南市中国法院的指示。

基于南京政府刚刚下达给大上海当局的决定，新命令是地方当局就其在沪俄侨管辖权问题进行查询后的结果，并最终裁定俄侨受南市运作法院的管辖。

《远东时报》代表就此事宜采访伊万诺夫先生时，他表示该命令正在翻译成俄文，随后将在当地俄文报纸上刊登。“目前——伊万诺夫先生继续说道——我只能说，此命令禁止俄侨向第一和第二特区地方法院提起诉讼。该命令对俄侨至关重要，因为作为对收留我们的国家忠诚的人，我们必须执行南京政府的命令”。

俄侨委员会将于今日就此事项召开特别会议。

此外，当地各界希望俄侨管辖权问题能以完全无痛的方式解决，因为目前正就……

俄侨委员会收到确立俄侨受南市司法机构管辖的命令

俄侨委员会主席N. A. 伊万诺夫昨日收到大上海代理市长苏希文先生的命令，确认已故市长傅筱庵先生发布的关于俄侨受南市中国法院管辖的规定。

新命令基于南京政府的直接决议，该决议刚由大上海当局收到。此项决议是地方当局查询在沪俄侨成员管辖权问题的结果，并以明确形式解决了这一问题，将在沪俄侨人口置于南市司法机构的管辖之下。

“我目前无法就所获命令的实质内容提供具体解释，”俄侨委员会主席N. A. 伊万诺夫在回答我们的询问时说，“因为我们刚刚收到该命令，目前正在翻译成俄文，之后将提供给当地媒体发表。目前我只能说，它禁止俄侨向第一和第二特区司法机构申诉，换言之，即禁止向第一和第二地方法院申诉，此前俄侨根据居住在国际公共租界还是法租界而受这些法院管辖。”

毫无疑问，该命令具有重要意义，因为我们有义务服从南京政府的指令。在此情况下，作为对收留我们的国家忠诚的公民，我可以补充说，俄侨委员会将立即采取一切可能措施，使这一过渡对俄侨尽可能减少痛苦，并尽可能充分保障其权利和利益。特别是，我们将立即提出在俄侨委员会下设特别仲裁法庭的问题，俄侨可在其中解决纠纷和误解。

自然，这样的仲裁法庭只能处理民事案件。至于刑事案件，自然应属于王室法院，即政府法院的管辖范围。

今天，11月8日，俄侨委员会将举行专门会议，讨论收到的命令。

顺便提一下，当地各界认为，俄侨受司法机构管辖的问题可能会以完全无痛的形式解决，因为目前正就在进行关于将第一和第二地方法院移交给南京政府管辖的谈判。在

26 9 40

SMP Shrugs At Fu's Rule To
Try Russians In Nantao Court

As Nicolai A. Ivanow, Chairman of the Russian Emigrants' Society, approached the Consular Body on instructions from Mayor Fu Siao-en with the proposal that all Russian emigres here be tried in the Nantao court of the City Government of Greater Shanghai, Major Kenneth M. Bourne, Commissioner of the S.M.P., told THE CHINA PRESS yesterday that Mr. Ivanow has no right to create or agree to such a ruling. As far as the Settlement police are concerned, he declared, Russian emigres arrested in the Settlement will continue to face trial in the First Special District Court.

Mr. Ivanow, the stocky, bald lawyer who was made Chairman of the Emigrants' Society following the murder of Charles E. Metzler, disclaimed any responsibility for the move. Initiative for the action, he said, came from Mayor Fu's administration and not from the Emigrants' Society. He would not comment on the legal aspects of a change that would bring Russian emigres under the power of a court subservient to the Japanese authorities through the City Government.

"We Must Obey"

"I merely received the order from Mayor Fu Siao-en, and I sent a letter to the Consular Body," he told THE CHINA PRESS. "I can't tell you anything more than that. It was not my doing. As you know we must obey the orders of the authorities."

Asked to comment on Major Bourne's declaration that the Settlement police would continue to bring arrested Russian emigres to the First Special District Court, Mr. Ivanow said he did not know how Mayor Fu's ruling would be brought into effect.

Mr. Ivanow, it will be recalled, was made Chairman of the Russian Emigrants' Committee at a closed meeting between him, Colonel Lu Ying, Police Commissioner of the City Government of Greater Shanghai, and Bishop John, clerical head of the Russian community.

Russians Worried

Considerable apprehension swept through the Russian community yesterday when the move to try Russians in the Nantao Court became known. Some saw in the move the first shot in the long expected reforms that, it was feared, would follow Mr. Ivanow's accession to his post.

Russian circles flayed the step. "The move is not legal as far as those Russians living in the foreign areas are concerned," a prominent lawyer told THE CHINA PRESS. "Russians living in the Concession and the Settlement are under the jurisdiction of the First and Second Special District Courts. How can they be forced to go to Nantao if they are under the Council's and not the City Government administration?

"If the plan comes into effect, it would mean that the two Councils are under the laws of the Special Municipality, and would also mean that all foreigners without extra-territorial rights should be tried in the Nantao court.

"It is definitely not legal, and I sincerely hope that the authorities will not allow it. It must also be remembered that a Russian lawyer would in all probability not be allowed into the Nantao Court to protect the interests of his clients."

RECEIVED BY
REGISTRY
DATE 26/9/40

1940 年 9 月 26 日

工部局警务处对傅筱庵下令在南市法院审判俄国人一事不予理会

当俄国侨民协会主席 Nicolai A. Ivanow 奉上海市市长傅筱庵之命，向领事团提出建议，称所有在沪俄国侨民均应由大上海市政府的南市法院审理时，工部局警务处处长 Kenneth M. Bourne 少校昨日告诉《字林西报》，Ivanow 先生无权制定或同意此类规定。他宣称，就租界警方而言，在租界被捕的俄国侨民将继续在第一特区地方法院受审。

Ivanow 先生是一位身材矮壮、秃顶的律师，在 Charles E. Metzler 遇刺身亡后出任侨民协会主席，他否认对此举承担任何责任。他说，这一行动的主动权来自傅市长的行政当局，而非侨民协会。对于这一将使俄国侨民受制于通过市政府听命于日本当局的法院的变更所涉及的法律层面，他不愿置评。

“我们必须服从”

“我只是收到了傅筱庵市长的命令，并给领事团发了一封信，”他告诉《字林西报》。“我不能告诉你更多的内容。这不是我做的。如你所知，我们必须服从当局的命令。”

当被要求评论 Bourne 少校关于租界警方将继续将被捕的俄国侨民带往第一特区地方法院的声明时，Ivanow 先生表示，他不知道傅市长的规定将如何实施。

回想起来，Ivanow 先生是在他与大上海市政府警察局局长卢英上校以及俄国社区宗教领袖 John 主教举行的一次闭门会议后，被任命为俄国侨民委员会主席的。

俄国人感到担忧

昨日，当试图在南市法院审判俄国人的消息传开后，俄国社区中弥漫着相当大的焦虑情绪。一些人将此举动视为预期已久的改革的第一枪，人们担心这些改革会随着 Ivanow 先生上任而随之而来。

俄国圈子猛烈抨击这一举措。“就居住在外籍人居住区的俄国人而言，此举不合法，”一位著名律师告诉《字林西报》。“居住在法租界和公共租界的俄国人受第一和第二特区地方法院的管辖。如果他们受工部局而非市政府的管理，怎么能强迫他们去南市呢？

“如果该计划生效，将意味着两个工部局受制于特别市的法律，也意味着所有没有治外法权的外国人都应在南市法院受审。

“这绝对不合法，我真诚希望当局不会允许这样做。还必须记住，俄国律师很可能不被允许进入南市法院以保护其当事人的利益。”

登记处收讫
日期 1940 年 9 月 26 日

New Court Order
Affects Russians

Local Community To
Come Under Nantao
Jurisdiction

White Russian emigres in
Shanghai, totaling nearly 26,000
persons, will in future come
under the jurisdiction of the
Nantao District Court in matters
affecting civil and criminal
cases, according to an order
issued by Mayor Fu Siao-en of
the Shanghai Special Munici-
pality, the Shanghai Evening
Post learned today.

Mr. N. Ivanow, present chair-
man of the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, who succeeded Mr.
Chas. E. Metzler after the
latter was assassinated last
August, revealed this morning
that he had received the instruc-
tions from Mayor Fu.

Informing Authorities

The Russian emigre head stat-
ed that he had already given
his assent to Mayor Fu's decision,
and added that he is informing
the Consular Body, the Shang-
hai Municipal Council and the
French Municipal Council in
the matter.

Mr. Ivanow explained, however,
that the decision is not likely to
take effect until a number of de-
tails are settled so that normal
court procedure can be maintain-
ed.

Mayor Fu's Decision

It was revealed that Mayor Fu
had indicated that all cases at
present pending or in the course of
hearing before the District Courts
in the French Concession and
International Settlement will be
permitted to continue and be con-
cluded in these courts.

However, Mayor Fu's instruc-
tions, it is understood, stipulated

to the Nantao District Court
which is under the supervision of
the Shanghai Special Municipality.

Will Affect Courts

It is believed that the new mea-
sures launched by the Shanghai
Special Municipality will shortly
affect the District Courts in the
International Settlement and
French Concession, where Russian
emigres, and other residents with-

At the same time, the change

Municipality recalls previous de-

be transferred to the present Chin-
ese municipality under Mayor Fu
Siao-en.
pages.zh:
新法院命令
影响俄国人

本地社区将纳入
南市管辖

据《上海晚邮报》今日获悉，根据上海特别市市长傅筱庵发布的一项命令，在沪的近 26,000 名白俄侨民今后在涉及民事和刑事案件方面，将受南市地方法院管辖。

现任俄国侨民委员会主席 N. Ivanow 先生在今年八月 Charles E. Metzler 先生遇刺后接替其职位，他今晨透露，他已收到傅市长的指示。

通报当局

这位俄国侨民领袖表示，他已同意傅市长的决定，并补充说，他正在就此事通知领事团、上海工部局和法国公董局。

然而，Ivanow 先生解释说，在敲定许多细节以维持正常的法院程序之前，该决定不太可能生效。

傅市长的决定

据悉，傅市长曾表示，目前仍在法租界和公共租界地方法院待决或审理中的所有案件，将被允许在这些法院继续并进行完结。

然而，据了解，傅市长的指示规定，本月出现的所有新案件必须提交给受上海特别市监督的南市地方法院。

将影响法院

人们认为，上海特别市推出的新措施不久将影响公共租界和法租界的地方法院，俄国侨民以及其他没有治外法权的居民在这些法院接受司法管辖。

同时，上海特别市命令的这一变化让人回想起此前要求将租界和法租界的中国地方法院的管辖权移交给傅筱庵市长领导下的现行中国市政府的要求。

pages.en:
Jurisdiction Over
Russians Changed

Russian Leader Announces
Compliance with Order of
Mayor Fu Siao-en

What is characterized among certain Russian quarters as a coup d'etat has been achieved by the extra-Settlement authorities through an announcement made yesterday by Mr. N. A. Ivanow, chairman of the Russian Emigrants' Committee, of compliance with an order of Mayor Fu Siao-en placing the 26,000 White Russians in Shanghai under the jurisdiction of the Nantao District Court in all civil and criminal cases. This jurisdiction formerly had been vested in the Chinese courts in the Settlement and French Concession.

Mr. Ivanow, who is a practising Russian lawyer and who was at one time assessor of the former Mixed Court, recently was appointed head of the Russian Emigrants' Committee in succession to Mr. Chas. E. Metzler, Russian leader who was assassinated some time ago.

The new Russian official is reported to be preparing to notify the Shanghai Municipal Council, the French Municipal Council and the local Consular Body of his compliance with the order of the mayor. It is understood that the order will not come into force for some time, pending settlement of a number of small details.

No Immediate Interference

It was reported that Mayor Fu will allow all cases involving Russians pending in the Chinese courts in the Settlement and French Concession to be concluded without a transfer of jurisdiction to avoid complications in the future. The Nantao District Court is under the supervision of the Shanghai Special Municipality.

Russians in China at one time enjoyed extraterritorial rights. Following the last world war and the Russian revolution they came under Chinese jurisdiction. With the overthrow of the Czarist Government many White Russians in this country renounced their Russian nationality and took Chinese passports, some of them even adopting Chinese names, which caused some confusion to officials of foreign countries who in some instances obdurately refused to recognize an apparent European as a citizen of the Republic of China.
pages.zh:
对俄国人的
管辖权变更

俄国领导人宣布
遵从傅筱庵市长的命令

某些俄国阶层称之为政变的局面，已由租界外当局通过俄国侨民委员会主席 N. A. Ivanow 先生昨日的公告得以实现，公告表示遵从傅筱庵市长的命令，将在沪的 26,000 名白俄置于南市地方法院对所有民事和刑事案件的管辖之下。此前，这种管辖权归属于租界和法租界的中国法院。

Ivanow 先生是一名执业俄国律师，曾是前混合法庭的陪审员，最近被任命为俄国侨民委员会负责人，接替不久前遇刺的俄国领导人 Chas. E. Metzler 先生。

据报道，这位新的俄国官员正准备通知上海工部局、法国公董局和当地领事团，他表示遵从市长的命令。据了解，在解决一些细小细节之前，该命令暂时不会生效。

暂无即时干预

据报道，傅市长将允许所有涉及俄国人的、在租界和法租界中国法院待决的案件在不转移管辖权的情况下结案，以避免未来的复杂情况。南市地方法院受上海特别市监督。

在华俄国人曾一度享有治外法权。在上次世界大战和俄国革命之后，他们受中国管辖。随着沙皇政府的推翻，许多在华白俄放弃了俄国国籍并领取了中国护照，其中一些人甚至采用了中文名字，这给外国官员造成了一些混乱，他们在某些情况下顽固地拒绝承认明显的欧洲人为中华民国公民。

pages.en:
Nantao Court Jurisdiction
For Local Russians

New Order Issued By Mayor Fu Hsiao-en Gets
Assent Of Russian Emigre Chairman;
Measures To Be Enforced Shortly

According to an order, issued yesterday by Mayor Fu Hsiao-en of the Shanghai Special Municipality and agreed to by Mr. M. A. Ivanow chairman of the Russian Emigrants' Committee, White Russian emigres in Shanghai will shortly come under the jurisdiction of the Nantao District Court with regard to all criminal and civil cases.

Mr. Ivanow, who succeeded to the post of chairman of the Russian Emigrants' Committee after the assassination of Mr. Charles S. Metzler last August, confirmed that he had received notification of the order yesterday morning.

It was also learnt that the Russian emigre official had informed the Consular Body, the Shanghai Municipal and the French Municipal Council of the new situation.

Settling Details

The final decision, however, it was stated by Mr. Ivanow, would not be likely to be enforced till numerous details in present court procedure can be ironed out.

Meanwhile, it was revealed that the new order will not affect those cases involving Russians either in the course of hearing or due to come up shortly in the District Courts both in the Settlement and the Concession. These, it was stated by Mayor Fu, would be allowed to be concluded as in the normal course of events.

On the other hand, Mayor Fu pointed out, all new cases coming up this month must conform to the new order and must be referred to the Nantao District Court, which is under the jurisdiction of the Shanghai Special Municipality.

It was also learnt that Russians involved in law suits under the new order, either as defendants or complainants, would only be allowed defence by Chinese lawyers.

The new rule, it is thought, may possibly affect the District Courts in the Settlement and French Concession where Russians, as well as those without extraterritoriality rights, are involved in civil and criminal suits.

本地俄国人受
南市法院管辖

傅筱庵市长发布新命令获
俄国侨民主席同意；
措施即将实施

根据上海特别市市长傅筱庵昨日发布并经俄国侨民委员会主席 M. A. Ivanow 先生同意的命令，在沪白俄侨民不久将在所有刑事和民事案件方面受南市地方法院管辖。

Ivanow 先生在去年八月 Charles S. Metzler 先生遇刺后接任俄国侨民委员会主席一职，他证实已于昨日上午收到该命令的通知。

另悉，这位俄国侨民官员已将这一新情况通知了领事团、上海工部局和法国公董局。

敲定细节

然而，Ivanow 先生表示，在目前法院程序中的众多细节得到理顺之前，最终决定不太可能执行。

与此同时，据悉新命令不会影响那些正在租界和法租界地方法院审理或即将开庭的涉及俄国人的案件。傅市长表示，这些案件将被允许按正常程序结案。

另一方面，傅市长指出，本月出现的所有新案件必须符合新命令，并必须提交给受上海特别市管辖的南市地方法院。

另悉，根据新命令卷入诉讼的俄国人，无论是作为被告还是原告，只允许由中国律师进行辩护。

人们认为，新规定可能会影响公共租界和法租界的地方法院，俄国人以及那些没有治外法权的人在这些法院涉及民事和刑事诉讼。

Questioned concerning the reason for the

that about six years ago, whilst occupying premises on
Yalu Road, her husband bought six steel rollers from

Sino-Japanese hostilities. During the last event the
rollers were looted from the shop and an argument arose

Daung Zing Sze has been warned to inform this
Station when her husband returns. Also, detectives will
keep in communication with the family.
The nearest police to the scene of the offence
were on duty near Seymour Road Market. They were not
informed of what had occurred until after Daung Ching
Tah and his wife had been taken away.
Attached are statements taken from Daung Zing
Sze, Daung Mei Dien and Yao Koh Wo.

after Yao Koh Wo returned with the car to the garage, it
was taken out again by another chauffeur with several

Made by D. L. Pan Lien Pih Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

The court in Pootung, the Western District
Court in the Great China University Building, Chungshan
Road, and the branch office of the Western District
Court at 92 Jessfield Road completed their liquidation
at the end of June and were amalgamated with the
Nantao Court on the former site of the Si Cheng (西成)
Primary School, Boon Lai Road, Nantao, on July 1, 1940.
The court in Nantao has now been named the
Shanghai District Court with Nyi Lun Kwei (嚴魁)
(President of Nantao Court) as President.

up his new post as president of the Taitsang District
Court.
The Chinese court at Pootung is now busily
engaged in winding up its affairs and it is expected
that the liquidation will be finished by the end of
the current month.

AMALGAMATION OF CHINESE COURTS

It is reported that, subject
to instructions from the Ministry of Justice at Nanking,
the Shanghai District Courts at Pootung and Western

《每日新闻》

中国法院的合并

据报道，遵照南京司法部的指示，浦东和西区的上海地方法院将于6月1日合并。新法院将在南市蓬莱路办公，受理民事和刑事案件。
严伦魁（Nyien Lun-kwei）先生已被任命为新法院院长。西区法院院长被提名为新法院庭长，而浦东法院院长被任命为太仓地方法院院长。

pages.en:
SHANGHAI TIMES

Branches of the Shanghai District Court will be merged into a single unit on June 1 to be located on Penglai Road, Nantao, the Shanghai "Mainichi" reported yesterday. The Court will handle both civil and criminal cases, it was stated, under the laws of the old National Government as they existed prior to the outbreak of Sino-Japanese hostilities. The branch courts which will disappear as a result of the merger are those in Pootung and the Western District Mr. Yen Lun-kwei will serve as the First President of the District Court, the paper said.
pages.zh:
《字林西报》

据《每日新闻》昨日报道，上海地方法院的各分院将于6月1日合并为一个单位，地点设在南市蓬莱路。据报道，该法院将依据中日敌对行动爆发前旧国民政府存在的法律，处理民事和刑事案件。因合并而撤销的分院是浦东和西区的法院。该报称，严伦魁（Yen Lun-kwei）先生将担任地方法院首任院长。

translation from Russian.

WHAT WE HAVE COME TO!

At last an explanation of the sad and known to all
Shanghai case of Arutikoff appeared in the newspaper "Rus"
of January 27. But, apart from impudent lies, it contains
nothing of importance.

In the first place the newspaper has failed to ex-
plain why the Russian community was informed of this unlaw-
not/
ful and criminal affair by a bolshevist newspaper and by the
emigrant press? Because all our so-called national and in-
dependent newspapers are such only in theory. In reality they
all are controlled by somebody, and it was for fear of that
somebody that they did not publish any timely information on
the subject in question.

Secondly, nothing has been said in order to explain
why a resident of Wayside was arrested by the Pootung police,
and not by the Municipal Police, and why he was taken not to
the Ward Road Gaol, but to a gaol in Pootung? Finally, why
Arutikoff, who contracted a contagious disease after his ar-
rest, was not sent to a prison hospital, but was kept in a
cell together with other prisoners for over one week? Gene-
rally speaking, it will be seen from all explanations offered
that a newspaper bearing a high-sounding national name "Rus"
defends not the Russian interests, but those of somebody else.

With regard to the Emigrants Committee and our
leaders, their activities in defence of rights and interests
of Russian emigrants have been known to us for a long time.

We remember how you have saved from execution
D.I.Gustoff, a Russian patriot, and 9 unfortunate refugees
who escaped from the Soviet paradise. Only you, yes, you
alone are responsible for the death of those people! And how
many more revolting acts are being perpetrated in respect
of Russian emigrants, acts of which you alone pretend to be
pages.zh:
俄文译文。

我们落到了什么地步！

1月27日的《俄罗斯》报终于对上海众所周知的阿鲁蒂科夫（Arutikoff [原文如此，前文为Krutikoff]）悲惨案件作出了解释。但是，除了无耻的谎言外，它没有任何重要内容。

首先，该报未能解释为何俄国社区是通过一家布尔什维克报纸和流亡者报刊得知这起非法和犯罪事件的？因为我们所有所谓的民族和独立报纸仅在理论上是如此。实际上，它们都受某人控制，正是出于对那个人的恐惧，它们没有就相关问题发布任何及时的信息。

其次，没有任何解释说明为何一名韦赛德（Wayside [音译]）居民是由浦东警察而非工部局警察逮捕的，以及为何他被带往的不是华德路监狱，而是浦东的一所监狱？最后，为何阿鲁蒂科夫在逮捕后感染了传染病，却没有被送往监狱医院，而是与其他囚犯一起关在牢房里超过一周？总的来说，从提供的所有解释可以看出，一家挂着响亮的民族名称“俄罗斯”的报纸捍卫的不是俄国人的利益，而是其他人的利益。

至于难民委员会和我们的领导人，他们在捍卫俄国难民权利和利益方面的活动，我们早已知晓。

我们记得你们是如何将俄国爱国者D.I.古斯托夫（D.I.Gustoff）和9名逃离苏联天堂的不幸难民从死刑中拯救出来的。只有你们，是的，只有你们才对那些人的死亡负责！还有多少针对俄国难民的令人厌恶的行为正在发生，而你们却假装对

ignorant?
the bolshevist newspaper "novostiunia",which you
blame so much,is your own creature and a result of your das-
tard non-political and opportunist attitude.
yes, messrs russian emigrants,as long as our leaders
and press are under a foreign influence and hold their per-

这些行为一无所知？
你们如此严厉谴责的布尔什维克报纸《新闻报》（novostiunia [原文如此，应为Novosti Dnia]），就是你们自己的产物，是你们怯懦的非政治和机会主义态度的结果。
是的，俄国难民先生们，只要我们的领导人和报刊受到外国影响，并将个人利益置于国家利益之上；只要我们没有真正民族和独立的报刊——像这样的案件就会再次发生，因为确实没有人来保卫我们。

pages.en:
Наконецъ то въ газ. "Русь" отъ 27 января появилось объя-
сненіе, уже давно извѣстнаго всему Ланхаю, печальнаго случая
съ казакомъ Крутиковымъ, но въ которомъ кромѣ наглаго вранья
ничего существеннаго нѣтъ.
Во первыхъ, газета ничего не говоритъ почему именно въ
большевитской газет инфорировали русскую колонію объ
этомъ незаконно преступномъ случаѣ, а не въ эмигрантскихъ
газетахъ? — а потому, что всѣ наши, такъ называемыя національныя
независимыя газеты существуютъ только на бумаг, а на дѣлѣ —
всѣ они отъ кого либо да въ зависимости и есть только поэтому,
ради страха Іудейскаго, они отказались безотговорочно что либо
сообщить объ этомъ.
Во вторыхъ, нѣтъ никакого указанія, почему житель Бейсай-
да могъ быть арестованъ полиціей Путунга, а не муниципальной
и препровожденъ не на Востокъ рѣкъ, а въ Цутунгскую тюрьму?
Почему, наконецъ, арестованный Крутиковъ и въ послѣдствіи за-
болѣвшій заразной болѣзнью, не былъ отправленъ въ тюремный
госпиталь, а продолжалъ оставаться въ общей камерѣ, среди дру-
гихъ арестованныхъ, болѣе недѣли? Въ общемъ изъ всѣхъ этихъ
разъясненій видно, что газета носящая громкое національное
названіе "Русь" защищаетъ чьи то интересы, но только далеко
не русскіе.
Что касается эмигрантскаго комитета и нашихъ лидеровъ,
то ихъ дѣятельность въ отношеніи защиты правъ и интересовъ
русскихъ эмигрантовъ, намъ давно хорошо извѣстна.
Помнимъ мы какъ вы спасли отъ разстрѣла русскаго патріо-
та Д. М. Густова и тѣхъ несчастныхъ 9 человѣкъ, вырвавшихся изъ
совѣтскаго рая. Въ смерти этихъ людей исключительно виновны
вы, да, только вы! а сколько творится еще гнусныхъ дѣлъ въ
отношеніи русскихъ эмигрантовъ, но вамъ лишь одними ушами
давно не извѣстныхъ?....
Относительно же большевитской газеты "Новости дня" на
которую вы такъ злуете, то это ваше порожденіе въ слѣдствіи
вашей гнусной аполитичности и соглашательства.
Нѣтъ, господа русскіе эмигранты, пока наши лидеры и пресса
находятся подъ иностраннымъ вліяніемъ и свои личные интересы
ставятъ выше національныхъ и пока мы не сможемъ имѣть насто-
ящую русскую національную и независимую прессу не на бумагѣ
только, какъ въ данное время, а на дѣлѣ — у насъ будутъ пов-
торяться подобнаго рода случаи, ибо дѣйствительно не кому
pages.zh:
终于，在1月27日的《罗斯》（Russ）报上刊登了一则解释，关于哥萨克人克鲁季科夫（Krutikov）的不幸事件，此事早已为整个上海所知，但该解释除了厚颜无耻的谎言外，并无任何实质内容。
首先，该报只字未提为何是通过布尔什维克报纸而非流亡者报纸向俄国侨民通报这一非法犯罪案件的？——这是因为我们所有所谓的民族独立报纸仅存在于纸面上，而实际上——它们都受制于某些人，且仅仅出于对犹太人的恐惧，它们才无条件地拒绝报道此事的任何消息。
其次，没有任何说明指出，为何贝赛德（Bayside）的居民会被浦东警方而非工部局警方逮捕，并被送往浦东监狱而非河东地区？最后，为何被捕的克鲁季科夫以及随后患上传染病的他，没有被送往监狱医院，而是继续与其他囚犯一起关押在普通牢房中超过一周？总之，从所有这些解释中可以看出，这家挂着响亮的民族名称“罗斯”的报纸是在维护某些人的利益，但绝非俄国人的利益。
至于流亡者委员会和我们的领袖，他们在保护俄国流亡者权利和利益方面的活动，我们早已熟知。
我们记得你们是如何将俄国爱国者D. M. 古斯托夫（Gustov）以及那9名从苏维埃天堂逃出的不幸者从枪决中拯救出来的。这些人的死亡完全归咎于你们，是的，只归咎于你们！还有多少针对俄国流亡者的卑鄙行径正在发生，而你们却早已充耳不闻？....
至于你们如此憎恨的布尔什维克报纸《每日新闻》（Novosti Dnya），那是由于你们的卑鄙非政治性和妥协态度而产生的结果。
不，俄国流亡者先生们，只要我们的领袖和媒体处于外国影响之下，并将个人利益置于民族利益之上，只要我们不能拥有真正不仅在纸面上、而且在事实上的俄国民族独立媒体——像目前这样——此类事件就会反复发生，因为确实没有人

B'Well
January 29th., 40.
1.

False Alarm: Kidnapping.

At 10.50a.m. 29/1/40 a telephone message was received
from C.C.R. to the effect that a kidnapping was being
perpetrated at No. 27 Lane 608 Yu Yuen Road.
The station alarm was rung and all available
men turned out and attended however on arrival found
that members of the S.C.G.P. Bureau were on the above
premises.
From enquiries made by D.I. Tabrum the undersigned
and J.D.S. 142 it was learnt that at about 10.40a.m.
29/1/40 a party of 4 male Chinese in plain clothes
entered the above address and asked an amah if Dai Tsah
Ching (戴則均) was at home and were told "yes" on
receiving this reply the 4 men proceeded to the upstairs
rooms and the inmates, not knowing who these men were,
became afraid and thought that the men were kidnappers
therefore one of the inmates telephoned C.C.R. whilst
Dai Tsah Ching's son one Dai Ah Kyeu (戴阿居) ran out
of the house to the entrance to Lane 608 Yu Yuen Road
where he encountered 3 members of the S.C.G.P. Bureau
and reported to them that he suspected kidnappers were
on his father's premises, these 3 S.C.G.P.B. members
accompanied him to the premises and were enquiring
when the B'Well Police Party arrived.

1.

误报：绑架案。

1940年1月29日上午10时50分，中央巡捕房（C.C.R.）接到电话报告，称愚园路608弄27号正在发生绑架案。
警局警报响起，所有可用警力出动并前往现场，然而到达后发现江苏高等法院第二分院（S.C.G.P. Bureau）的人员已在上述地点。
经警探长塔布鲁姆（Tabrum）、本报告撰写人及第142号便衣警探（J.D.S. 142）查询得知，1940年1月29日上午10时40分左右，四名身穿便服的中国男子进入上述地址，询问一名女佣戴则均（Dai Tsah Ching）是否在家，得到肯定答复后，这四人上楼进入房间。屋内人员不知这些人是谁，感到害怕，认为他们是绑匪，因此其中一人致电中央巡捕房，而戴则均之子戴阿居（Dai Ah Kyeu）跑出家门至愚园路608弄口，在那里遇到三名江苏高等法院第二分院的人员，并向他们报告说怀疑有绑匪在其父亲住所内，这三名江苏高等法院第二分院人员陪同他返回住所并进行查问，此时百老汇路巡捕房警队抵达。

FURTHER REPORT
Date Jan., 13th, 19 40.
Subject. Illegal Functioning by Officials of the Shanghai City Government.
Made by D.I. Cumming, Forwarded by

Sir,
Further to previous report dated 30-12-39, on the above subject, it has now been ascertained that Phillip Kutikoff was admitted to the General Hospital on 4-1-40. He died at 11.30 p.m., 13-1-40, the cause of death being enteritis and perforated intestine. He was attended to by Dr. Squires who issued a certificate to the above effect. The deceased was buried at Hungjoo Cemetery on the afternoon of 13-1-40.

The wife of deceased was interviewed by the under-signed and stated that her husband was released from Pootung on 2-1-40 when a sum of $200.00 was paid into the Court there. According to the female, her husband developed a stomach complaint during his incarceration in Pootung. He, however, made no complaint of ill-treatment during this period.

Dr. Squires will be communicated with, so that further details regarding the cause of death may be obtained.

D.I.

D.D.O. "D" Division.

D.C. Special Branch.

继1939年12月30日关于上述主题的先前报告之后，现已查明菲利普·库季科夫（Phillip Kutikoff）于1940年1月4日入住广慈医院。他于1940年1月13日晚上11时30分去世，死因为肠炎和肠穿孔。由斯奎尔斯医生（Dr. Squires）诊治，并出具了上述证明。死者于1940年1月13日下午安葬于虹桥公墓。

将与斯奎尔斯医生联系，以获取有关死因的更多细节。

Translation of letter received from Colonel Loo Ying.
--------------------------

December 27,1939.

Dear Shao Liang,

I have received the report from Wayside Station
and made inquiries at the Pootung Branch of the Shanghai
District Court. According to the reply from the Court,
the Indian Ram Singh is in possession of a promissory
note for the sum of $400 signed by Koutikoff, but the
latter, at the hearing in the Court, admitted that he
actually borrowed $200 and was unable to liquidate this
debt. As he could not produce a guarantor, he was detained
in the Detention Room. The Court is an independent organ
and the fact that Koutikoff is being detained is because
he is a non-treaty national. I wish I could help in the
matter but it is not within my power to do so, so please
inform those concerned.

Loo Ying.

D.C. (Ct. Br.).
Sir,
Forwarded.
Jan 20/40.
- D.C. Crimi
Information

Ram Singh was interviewed at Headquarters on 21.12.39
and stated that he went to the Civil Branch of the
District Court on Weihaiwei Road seven or eight months
ago, where he was told by a foreign inspector that it
was difficult for that Court to handle cases north of
the Creek. Ram Singh admitted that he went to Lootung
on his own initiative, this being in contradiction to
his statement made to D.I. Cumming.

D.S.I. Golder, who was attached to the said
Court at the time mentioned, states that he told Ram
Singh that it was almost impossible to serve summonses
north of the Creek at that time but also denies having
told the man to go to the Lootung Court. Ram Singh
when confronted by D.S.I. Golder admitted this to be
correct.

关于附件，放债人拉姆·辛格（Ram Singh）于1939年12月21日在总部接受问询，并表示他于七八个月前前往威海卫路地方法院民事庭，那里的一名外籍巡官告诉他，该法院难以处理苏州河以北的案件。拉姆·辛格承认他是主动前往卢通（Lootung，音译，指浦东或相关地区法院）的，这与他向警探长卡明所作的陈述相矛盾。

当时隶属于该法院的高级巡官戈尔德（Golder）表示，他曾告诉拉姆·辛格，当时几乎不可能在苏州河以北送达传票，但也否认曾指示此人去卢通法院。当与高级巡官戈尔德对质时，拉姆·辛格承认这是正确的。

据此于四个月前采取了该建议，此后浦东法院签发的四张传票均已送达 Kutikoff，但他均予无视。大约在

1939年10月19日晚7时许，两名来自浦东法院的中国官员
来到他（该印度人）的住所，应其要求，他陪同他们前往贝利亚路（Belial Road）144号，在那里他们如前所述逮捕了 Kutikoff。
值得注意的是，Kutikoff 被匆忙带离现场，未穿外套也未戴帽子，他请求回去取回衣物但被无视。他被步行护送至东区的一个码头，然后乘船渡往浦东。当天上午11时，他在该地受审，据该印度人称，他承认了债权主张，但表示无力支付。他随即被命令拘留，至今尚未获释。
当被问及另一名印度人的身份时，
Hari Singh 否认有此人陪同，并坚称那名女子是因为看到一名身份不明的印度路人出现在现场而得出此结论，但该路人与此事并无关联。

Sin Wan Pao:- 15.12.39 (pm)

WESTERN DISTRICT COURT POLICE OFFICER HELD UP

At about 9 a.m. yesterday a policeman of
attached to the District Court, who was escorting two hand-
cuffed middle aged men to the District Court located in the
premises of the former site of the Great China University
in the Western District, was held up by the British Defence
Force at the railway bridge on Jessfield Road in the British
Defence Sector, as the British military authorities had not
been informed beforehand of the passage of this escort
through the area. The party was later handed over to
Bubbling Well Police Station for interrogation. It is
said that the Court policeman was released yesterday
afternoon.

《新闻报》：1939年12月15日（下午版）

西区法院警察遭拦截

昨日上午9时许，一名隶属于西区法院的警察在护送两名戴手铐的中年男子前往位于西区原大夏大学旧址内的西区法院途中，在英军防区内的极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）铁路桥处被英国防卫部队拦截，原因是英国军方当局事先未获知该护送队伍将通过该区域。随后该伙人被移交至静安寺捕房进行讯问。据悉，该法院警察已于昨日下午获释。

Sir,

The attached is a copy of a proclamation issued
by the Procurators Bureau of the Shanghai City District
Court, which was found posted on the wall of the Toa Jute
Factory, (Japanese), No.64 Robison Road, O.O.L., under

November 26, 1939. Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News of Nov.25:

BRANCH OFFICE OF WESTERN DISTRICT BRANCH COURT
ESTABLISHED

On October 10, the Shanghai District Court,
in an endeavour to meet the convenience of local residents,
established a Branch Court on the premises of the Great
China University, Chungshan Road. As this Branch Court
is located in the extra-Settlement roads area, people
who want to get in touch with the Court must hold a pass
which will enable them to pass the barriers.
To facilitate persons who hold no passes to
have access to the Court, the Branch Court established a
Branch Office at premises House 6 Lane 92 Kinnear Road
off Jessfield Road on November 20.

1939年11月26日。晨间译文。

11月25日《华中日报》：

西区分院法院设立分院办事处

10月10日，上海特区地方法院为方便当地居民，在中山路大夏大学旧址设立了分院法院。由于该分院法院位于越界筑路区域，希望与法院联系的人士必须持有通行证才能通过关卡。
为方便无通行证人士接触法院，该分院法院于11月20日在极司菲尔路旁金尼尔路（Kinnear Road）92弄6号 premises 设立了一个分院办事处。

With reference to the attached translation of
an extract from Sin Shun Pao dated 17/11/39 on the
formation of a Sub-office by the Western Branch Court
in Jessfield Road, enquiries ascertain that the new
organ (sub-office) will be located in House 5 in No.92
Jessfield Road and will commence functioning in the
near future. It will handle the preliminary hearing
of all cases, civil and criminal, which take place in
the enclaves and is authorized to pass judgment in
connection with cases of a trivial nature. Cases
of an important nature, however, will be referred by the
sub-office to the Western Branch Court situated in the
former site of the Great China University, Chung San
Road, Chapei. Persons involved in law-suits who
are required to attend the Western Branch Court in Chung
San Road may enter Chapei via San Kwan Dang Bridge which
spans the Soochow Creek in the Jessfield Area or by the
various railway crossings in the Western District on
production of the summonses or special "passes" issued
to them by the new sub-office of the Court.
Liao Chung chien.

关于附件中1939年11月17日《新顺报》摘录的译文，该文摘报道了江苏高等法院第二分院在极司菲尔路设立分庭一事，经查询证实，该新机构（分庭）将设于极司菲尔路92号5号房屋，并将于近期开始运作。它将负责处理发生在租界飞地内的所有民事和刑事案件的初审，并有权对性质轻微的案件作出判决。然而，性质重要的案件将由该分庭移送至位于闸北中山路原大夏大学校址的江苏高等法院第二分院。需前往中山路江苏高等法院第二分院出庭的诉讼当事人，凭该法院新分庭签发的传票或特别“通行证”，可通过跨越苏州河极司菲尔区段的三官堂桥，或通过西区各铁路道口进入闸北。

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper) :-
17.11.39(AM)    NEW BRANCH COURT TO OPEN ON JESSFIELD ROAD

Since its formal inauguration, the Western
District Branch of the Shanghai District Court has been
kept very busy. However, owing to the fact that it is
located on Chungshan Road, much inconvenience is being
felt by the litigants due to lack of adequate means of
transportation. This on many occasions has served as a
good pretext for the defendants in their failure to
attend hearings of the cases against them, with the
result that the Court has found it difficult to conclude
some of the cases within a specified time.
It is learned that with a view to removing
this difficulty, President Loh (陸) of the Western
District Court has planned to establish a branch office
of the Court at the former site of the Western District
Branch of the Police Bureau at the corner of Jessfield
Road and Kinnear Road, so that all cases taking place
within the area can first be handled by this office before
being submitted to the Western District Court. Moreover,
in future the litigants will be able to gain entrance
to the Court on production of the summonses issued to them
by this office.
It is said that all necessary preparations
for the establishment of this office are nearing completion
and it is expected that the office will start functioning
on or about November 20.

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）:-
1939年11月17日（上午）    江苏高等法院第二分院将在极司菲尔路开庭

上海地方法院西区分院自正式成立以來，一直非常繁忙。然而，由于其位于中山路，因交通不便，诉讼当事人感到诸多不便。这在许多情况下成为被告不出庭应诉的良好借口，导致法院难以在规定时间内审结部分案件。

据悉，为消除此困难，西区法院院长陆氏（陸）计划在极司菲尔路与金尼尔路转角处、原警察局西区分局旧址设立法院分办事处，以便该区域内发生的所有案件先由该办事处处理，然后再提交至西区法院。此外，今后诉讼当事人凭该办事处签发的传票即可进入法院。

据说，设立该办事处的各项必要准备工作已接近完成，预计该办事处将于11月20日左右开始运作。

Ta Ying Yeh Pao dated Oct.28  J.10.39 (PM)

NEW COURT APPEARS IN WESTERN DISTRICT

In January this year the Shanghai District Court
in Nantao was formed with one Ni Lun-kwei (聶掄魁) as
President, and in March a Pootung Branch Court was inaugurated
with one Pang Ping-hsien (彭炳賢) as President.
On October 1, a Western District Branch Court,
which had been long reported amongst the public, made its
appearance in the former site of the Great China University
premises on Chung San Road (中山路) in the Western District.
It has two court rooms, with a detention house located in
a rear building.
Yesterday three proclamations were posted up
respectively by Loh Chi (羅熾), the President, Chow Cheng
(周準), the Chief Procurator, and King Tao (金濤), the
Chief of the Detention House of the Western District Branch
Court.
The Western District Branch Court will commence
functioning on October 11 and the area under its jurisdiction
will include the entire Western District, namely, Chapel
and Kiangwan on the north, Woosung and Yinghong on the
east, and Nanziang and Chenju on the west, as well as the
sector from Zau Ka Tu to Bubbling Well Road, Avenue Haig,
Hungjao Road and Zi Ka Wei. The area under its control
is far greater than that in Pootung and Nantao.

The "Central China Daily News" reports that the
Western District Branch Court will start functioning on
October 10, the Double Tenth Festival.

1939年10月28日《大英夜报》 J.10.39 (下午)

西区出现新法院

今年一月，位于南市的上海地方法院成立，由聂掄魁（Ni Lun-kwei）任院长；三月，浦东分院成立，由彭炳賢（Pang Ping-hsien）任院长。
10月1日，传闻已久的西区分院在西区中山路原大夏大学校址亮相。该院设有两个法庭，拘留所位于后方建筑内。
昨日，西区分院院长罗炽（Loh Chi）、首席检察官周準（Chow Cheng）以及西区分院拘留所主任金濤（King Tao）分别张贴了三份公告。
西区分院将于10月11日开始运作，其管辖区域包括整个西区，即北至曹家渡和江湾，东至吴淞和引翔港，西至南翔和真如，以及从曹家渡到静安寺路、海格路、虹桥路和徐家汇的区域。其控制区域远大于浦东和南市。

《华中日报》报道称，西区分院将于10月10日双十节开始运作。

The Western Branch of the "Shanghai District Court"
which, it is reported, was scheduled to be inaugurated
on September 1, 1939 at 623 Jessfield Road, O.U.L.,
failed to come into existence on the above date.
The Judicial Authorities of the Reformed Government,
it is said, wish to select a better locality for
the branch court which will control the Shanghai
Western District within and without the perimeter.
It is now suggested that the branch court be establish-
ed either at the former site of Great China Univer-

Fah Wah Village (within the perimeter) but so far
no definite decision has been arrived at although
Loh Chi (陸超) and Chiu Tsung (邱準) were
nominated some time ago as President and Procurator
respectively of the new branch court.

On September 6, the Sin Shun Pao published a
report to the effect that the Western Branch Court
was inaugurated on September 1 in Fah Wah Village
(translation of the report attached). Enquiries,
however, reveal that the information is groundless.

主题：“上海地方法院”西区分院。

由副督察长廖仲坚（Liao Chung Chien）呈报，经 R. W. Mac Cabe 特别侦探长转发。

据报道，“上海地方法院”西区分院原定于1939年9月1日在极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）623号（越界筑路区）正式成立，但上述日期并未成立。据称，维新政府司法当局希望为该院分院选择一个更好的地点，该分院将管辖界内及界外之上海西区。目前建议将分院设在中山路（界外）的原大夏大学旧址，或设在法华镇（界内），但迄今尚未作出明确决定，尽管陆超（Loh Chi）和邱準（Chiu Tsung）已于前一段时间被分别提名为新分院院长和检察官。

"Shanghai District Court" of the Reformed Government to

It is reported that the "Shanghai District Court" of the
Reformed Government will inaugurate a Western Branch on Septem-
ber 1, 1939 at House 623 (Chinese territory number plate),
Jessfield Road. Loh Chi (陸起), who formerly practised law in
Shanghai, and Chiu Tsung (邱準), a judge of the Pootung Branch
of the Shanghai District Court, have been appointed President
and Chief Procurator of the new judicial organ. A total of
$2,400.00 is reported to have been issued by the "Shanghai
District Court" to Loh Chi to defray expenses in connection with

the extra-Settlement roads area in the Western District.

House 623, Jessfield Road, O.O.L., which has been chosen as
the site of the Western Branch Court, is the property of the
Bank of China and is used as living quarters for the bank
employees. It is reported that the bank in question has received
a notice from the Japanese Military Police at 94 Jessfield Road,
demanding that the premises be vacated forthwith.

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS,
AUG 1 3 1939
Western District
Court Planned
“Reformed Government” to
Establish New Tribunal in
Jessfield Road
Efforts are now being made by the
“Reformed Government” at Nanking
to establish a court in the western
district of Shanghai and it is expected
that it will come into existence on
September 1.
A villa formerly belonging to a
Chinese bank located at 623 Jessfield
Road is stated to have been chosen
as the site for the new tribunal and
the people who occupy the building
have been advised by Japanese gen-
darmes to leave the place. The
Ministry of Justice of the new regime
is reported to have given only $2,400
as “opening expenses.”
A Chinese lawyer named Lu Chi
has tentatively been appointed chief
judge while the chief procurator will
be a Mr. Chiu Tsun, also a lawyer.
The areas under the jurisdiction of
the new court have been clearly
marked out to include the “badlands”
from Robison Road in the north to
the railway line at Siccawei in the
south. From east to the west the
court will control areas near Con-
naugh, Yengping and Bubbling Well
Roads up to the Shanghai Woosung
Railway in the west.
So far, the new regime has
established a district court in Nantao
but it has tried only a few cases.
The income is very little, so little
that it can hardly support itself, it
is stated. Since the local court can
not expect Nanking to provide run-
ning expenses always the officials are
said to have hit upon the bright idea
of starting another court in the
western district in order to increase
its income.
The new court in the making there-
fore will more or less be a subordinate
organization and may be known as
a branch court of the “puppet” Nantao
District Court. Apart from the
Nantao court and the new court being
established in the western district, a
judicial organization is also operating
in Pootung.
The courts in Pootung and Nantao
have not dealt with many cases and
it is interesting to recall that before
he could perform his duties the chief
judge of the Nantao court, Tu Fu
was assassinated. Since his assassina-
tion another judge was appointed but
practically no case of any importance
has so far been tried probably owing
to the fact that only a few poor
people are living out there.
The establishment of the new court
in the western district will also be
an important test of the ability of the
new regime to stamp out the
opium evil of which that dis-
trict is at present considered a dis-
tributing centre.

《字林西报》，
1939年8月13日
西区
法院计划中
“维新政府”拟在
极司菲尔路设立新法庭
南京“维新政府”正努力在上海西区设立一家法院，预计将于9月1日成立。
据悉，位于极司菲尔路623号的一栋原属某中国银行所有的别墅已被选为新法庭的址址，日本宪兵已劝告占据该建筑的人员离开。据报道，新政权的司法部仅提供了2,400美元作为“开办费”。
一位名叫陆起（Lu Chi）的中国律师被暂定为首席法官，而首席检察官将由另一位律师邱準（Chiu Tsun）担任。
新法院的管辖区域已明确划定，北起罗别根路（Robison Road），南至徐家汇（Siccawei）的铁路线。东西方向上，法院将控制康纳路（Connaugh）、英平路（Yengping）和静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）附近区域，直至西面的上海吴淞铁路。
到目前为止，新政权仅在南市设立了一家地方法院，但仅审理了少数案件。据说收入微薄，几乎无法维持自身运转。由于地方法院不能指望南京一直提供运营费用，官员们据说想出了一个好主意，即在西区再开设一家法院以增加收入。
因此，正在筹建中的新法院或多或少将是一个附属机构，可能被称为“傀儡”南市区法院的分院。除了南市法院和正在西区建立的新法院外，浦东也有一个司法机构在运作。
浦东和南市的法院处理的案件不多，有趣的是，在南区法院首席法官杜甫（Tu Fu）履行职责之前，他就被暗杀了。自他被暗杀后，又任命了一名法官，但迄今为止几乎没有审理过任何重要案件，这可能是因为那里只居住着少数穷人。
在西區建立新法院也将是对新政权铲除鸦片毒害能力的重要考验，该区目前被视为鸦片的分销中心。

Road, Pootung, which was reorganized from the

On May 1, 1939, Mr. Woo Wen-tsoong (吴文中),
Commissioner of the Bureau of Justice of the Shanghai
City Government in Pootung, received instructions
from Mayor Fu Siao-en of the City Government ordering
the closure of the Bureau before the end of May,
1939. In the meantime, however, civil and
criminal cases continue to be dealt with by the
Bureau pending a definite change in its future
status.

It is learned that some progress has been
made in the negotiations between the Mayor of the
Shanghai City Government and the Reformed Government
authorities for cooperation between the Bureau
of Justice in Pootung and the Shanghai District
Court. It has been agreed that the Bureau of
Justice in Pootung which has hitherto been functioning
under the Shanghai City Government, will from June
1, 1939, be reorganized and continue to function
as the Pootung Branch of the Shanghai District
Court, and that no changes in the personnel of the
Bureau will be effected in consequence of the
proposed reorganization.

It will be remembered that since its establish-
ment at the end of 1938, the Shanghai District Court
has been virtually unable to deal with cases against
the law owing to the non-cooperation of the Bureau
of Justice in Pootung which functions independently
under the Shanghai City Government (vide Special

Subject Shanghai District Court - new President appointed by the
Reformed Government
Made by D. I. Pen Lien Fih Forwarded by C. Crawford O.I.

In the middle of March 1939, the Reformed
Government appointed Mr. Nyi Lun Kwei (嚴掄魁)
as President of the Shanghai District Court to
succeed the late Doo Foo (屠復), who was
assassinated in the French Concession on February 16,
1939. Mr. Nyi assumed office at the beginning of
April in the Court's premises in the City, but owing
to the non-cooperation of the Bureau of Justice which
is still functioning independently under the Shanghai
City Government, there is little for him to do in his
official capacity.

On April 11, 1939, Nyi Lun Kwei posted copies of
a notice in the various localities in Nantao, calling
upon local legal practitioners to effect registration
with his Court before the end of the current month,
failing which they will be refused registration and
consequently barred from functioning in his Court.

Nyi Lun Kwei, alias Nyi Ching Woo (嚴經五),
aged 50, a native of Tai Shing, Kiangsu Province, has
been a member of the Shanghai Bar Association since
the summer of 1931. Formerly he maintained a law
office in his residence at No. 8 Zeu Kong Li, Rue de
l'Ouest, French Concession, but is now residing in
the New Asia Hotel in Hongkew.

Subject Memorial Service in honour of the late President of the
"Shanghai District Court"
Made by. D.I. Pan Lien-nih Forwarded by.

Following the assassination of Doo Foh
(屠復) alias Doo Tseng-kao (屠正鶴), the late
President of the "Shanghai District Court," which
took place in the French Concession on February 16,
1939, both the "Reformed Government" and the "Shanghai
City Government" are endeavouring to have their own
appointed man placed in the position as new president
of the Court. Because of this dispute, the
presidency remains vacant at present, and the Court
is not functioning.

During the forenoon of March 1, 1939, a
memorial service in honour of the late President
Doo Foh was held on the premises of the Court in the
Si Cheng Primary School, Boon Lai Road, Nantao.
Fee Kuo-hsi (費國禧), Presiding Judge of the
Criminal Division of the "Shanghai District Court"
officiated at the service. Members of the family
of the deceased and about fifty others mostly staff
members of the Court and representatives from the
"Reformed Government" and the "Shanghai City Government"
attended.

Throughout the proceedings, Japanese Military
Police were posted in the vicinity of the Court for
the purpose of protection.

NOTICE

The following notice, published by one
Kong Huei-tung (康次棟), appears in the "News Digest"
to-day:-

I work as a professor in the Shanghai Law
College and other schools; at the same time I practice as
a lawyer in Shanghai. I was appointed by the "News Digest"
last year as its legal advisor. I am living an honest life
and this is known to all my friends.

Recently a report appeared in the "Standard"
to the effect that following the murder of Tu Fu (屠復),
the President of the Shanghai District Court, the post of
the President of this Court would be filled by one Kong
Huei-tung, the puppet Chief Procurator of the Court. The
"Ta Ying Yeh Pao" and the "Chinese-American Daily News"

likewise published reports in which the name of one
Kong Hun-tung (康漢棟) was mentioned. This is an
indirect allegation against me. It is clear that some
dishonest and unscrupulous persons are planning to
defame my reputation. Letters have already been sent
to these papers asking for a correction of these false
reports and efforts are being made to find out the
source of these reports with a view to the institution
of legal proceedings. Lest the public should be misled
by these false allegations, this notice is published
for the information of the public.
pages.zh:
声明

康次棟今日在《新闻摘要》上发表以下声明：-

我在上海法学院及其他学校担任教授；同时在上海从事律师职业。去年我被《新闻摘要》聘为其法律顾问。我过着诚实的生活，这为我的所有朋友所知。

最近，《标准报》出现一则报道，称上海地方法院院长屠復遇害后，该院院长一职将由该院傀儡首席检察官康次棟接任。《大英夜报》和《中美日报》也发表了提及康漢棟名字的报道。这是对我的间接指控。显然，一些不诚实和无耻之徒正计划诽谤我的名誉。已去信这些报纸要求更正这些虚假报道，并正在努力查明这些报道的来源，以便提起法律诉讼。为避免公众被这些虚假指控误导，特发布此声明以供公众知悉。

February 18, 1939. Morning Translation.

Standard and other local newspapers :-

THE MURDER OF THE NANTAO DISTRICT COURT PRESIDENT

Tu Yoh (屠彥) alias Tu Tsong-koh (屠宗科),
President of the Nantao District Court of the "Reformed
Government," was murdered near his home on Rue Amiral
Bayle on the morning of February 16.
It is learned that in order to avoid danger
Tu used to reside in Nantao, but owing to the approach
of the China New Year and as there was little business
at the Court, he returned to his home in the French
Concession the other day and was shot dead. At present
Kong Hoon-tung (洪棟), the Chief Procurator, is
acting as President of the Court.
Tu held the post of President of the Nantao
Court for one month and half, during which period he made
a squeeze of $2,000.
Officials of the Judicial Office of the
"Reformed Government" are pleased at the news of Tu's
death because they will make another attempt to effect
a merger of the Judicial Office and the Nantao Court.

南市区法院院长被谋杀案

“维新政府”南市区法院院长屠彥（别名屠宗科）于2月16日上午在贝勒路（Rue Amiral Bayle）其住所附近被谋杀。
据悉，为躲避危险，屠某以往居住在南市，但由于中国新年临近，且法院业务稀少，他日前返回法租界的家中，随即被枪杀。目前，首席检察官洪棟（Kong Hoon-tung，音译）代理法院院长职务。
屠某担任南区法院院长一职一个半月，在此期间敛财2,000美元。
“维新政府”司法处的官员对屠某的死讯感到高兴，因为他们将再次尝试实现司法处与南区法院的合并。
