遇害

今晨，法租界的枪手以迅速而精准的手段，“处决”了两名当地大盗（Ta Tao）“傀儡”政权的雇员。上午11时35分，他们杀害了南区地方法院院长屠佛（Tu Foh）。上午7时50分，他们杀害了大盗水上警察局的侦探高洪兆（Kao Hung-chao）。

据香港向本地一家中文报纸发出的报道，重庆军事委员会已向南京和北平的“傀儡”政权发出警告：所有加入伪组织的中国人已获得最后悔过的机会。如果他们不悔改并继续充当敌人的工具，将依据《惩治汉奸条例》予以惩处。今日的杀戮与此报道相符。

档案
Q

pages.en:
Court Official
Tu Foh had been President of
the Nantao District Court, run by
the Ta Tao "government" for two
months. It has not started to
function yet, and is to be opened
officially on Chinese New Year
day This morning he was
slain swiftly and neatly, and so
far no witness of the deed has
been found. Walking alone down
the Tienziangli, about 150 yards
from its intersection with Route
Pere Dugout, gunmen halted him.
How many were in the party is
not known. But two neat holes
between Tu's eyes show that the
executioner or executioners wast-
ed no time. The two reports
brought a policeman to the scene,
and an ambulance was summoned
to take the man to the Ste. Marie
Hospital...but he was very dead.
Early Shooting
Four hours before this affair,
another Ta Tao employee met his
fate. He was Kao Hung-chao, 36
years old detective of the Ta Tao
Water Police. And he lived at
25 Tangzangli, off Rue Hennequin,
only a short distance from the
spot where Tu Foh was to die later
in the day.
Kao left his home this morning
at 7.35. As he walked out of his
front door he saw two men, who
closed in on him. Suddenly one
of the pair drew a pistol. He fired
four shots into Kao's head, kill-
ing him instantly, and then the
pair made their escape. A ricochet
bullet caused a scratch to the leg
of a passing housewife. And the
Ta Tao authorities lost the first of
the two they were to lose today.
pages.zh:
法院官员
屠佛担任由大盗“政府”运营的南区地方法院院长已有两个月。该院尚未开始运作，计划于农历新年正式开幕。今晨，他遭到迅速而利落的杀害，目前尚未找到目击者。当他独自走在天祥里（Tienziangli），距离杜古特神父路（Route Pere Dugout）交叉口约150码处时，枪手拦住了他。同行枪手人数不详。但屠佛双眼之间的两个干净利落的弹孔表明，行刑者并未浪费时间。两声枪响引来了一名警察，并呼叫救护车将死者送往圣玛丽医院（Ste. Marie Hospital）……但他已确然死亡。

清晨枪击
在此事发生四小时前，另一名大盗雇员遭遇了同样的命运。他是高洪兆，36岁，大盗水上警察局侦探。他居住在亨利路（Rue Hennequin）旁的唐藏里25号，距离屠佛当天晚些时候遇害的地点仅一小段距离。

高某今晨7时35分离开家。当他走出前门时，看见两名男子向他逼近。突然，其中一人拔出手枪。他向高的头部开了四枪，当场将其击毙，随后两人逃离现场。一颗跳弹擦伤了一名路过家庭主妇的腿部。大盗当局失去了他们今天将要失去的两名人员中的第一位。

pages.en:
SHANGHAI TIMES.
FEB 1 7 1939
01793

Two Chinese Officials
Shot Dead In French
Concession Yesterday

President Of Nantao Court And Detective Of
River Police Latest Victims Of Gunmen's
Bullets; Assassins Not Apprehended

THEORY ADVANCED THAT COURT CHIEF
MAY HAVE BEEN KILLED IN REVENGE

The suspicion that the assassination in the French Conces-
sion yesterday morning of Mr. Dou Tsang-kao, alias Dou Foh,
52-year-old President of the Nantao District Court, may have
been carried out by employees of the tribunal, was held in
certain quarters when it was brought to light that Mr. Dou had
been assaulted by employees of the court on Tuesday, for
allegedly withholding $6 from their respective salaries.

Mr. Dou, who was shot and killed instantly, at about 11.40
a.m. whilst walking in Tien Ziang Li, about 100 yards from
Rue Pere Dugout, was the second official to be murdered in
the Concession yesterday morning. The other assassination was
staged at about eight o'clock in the morning outside 145, Rue
Hennequin, the victim being Kao Hong-tsao, detective of the
new City Government City Police. He fell dead with four
bullet wounds in the head.

Although the theory was being
advanced in certain quarters that
the killing of the President of the
Nantao District Court, which institu-
tion is scheduled to open on Lunar

New Year's Day, was an act of re-
venge, it is more generally believed
that both the well-planned and per-
fectly-carried-out murders were poli-
tical in nature and were probably
the work of the same group of poli-
tical terrorists who have created a
reign of terror in the Western out-
side areas and in the International
Settlement recently.

No one was arrested following the
two assassinations yesterday and,
despite the fact that both killings
were carried out in broad daylight,
French Police could only locate eye-
witnesses of the murder of the River
Police detective. A Chinese woman
was wounded in the leg in this case,
by a ricochet bullet.

Court Employees' Complaint

It was reported that on Tuesday
Mr. Dou instructed that all the Nan-
tao District Court employees, includ-
ing gaolers and coolies, be paid in
view of the approaching Lunar New
Year Holidays. Some were given
one month's pay others received 20
days' wages and still others half-a-
month's pay. However, six dollars
was deducted from the pay envelope
of each man, for food supplied to
them. The employees protested,
stating that for the last 45 days the
only food they ate whilst on duty
was that which they brought from
their homes or bought themselves.

A minor riot ensued and the en-
raged employees attacked and beat
Mr. Dou, the report stated. Mr. Dou
managed to escape from the clutches
of the enraged employees with the
help of several other officials. Final-
ly, the whole matter was smoothed
over by Mr. Hsen Ching-tsu, secre-
tary of the tribunal.
pages.zh:
《字林西报》（SHANGHAI TIMES）。
1939年2月17日
01793

两名中国官员
昨日在法租界
被枪杀

南市法院院长与水上警察侦探
成为枪手子弹的最新受害者；刺客未被抓获

有观点认为法院主管
可能死于报复

当有人透露窦曾皋（Dou Tsang-kao，又名窦佛 Dou Foh），这位52岁的南区地方法院院长，曾在周二因被指控从员工工资中各扣留6美元而遭到法院员工袭击时，某些圈子便产生了一种怀疑，即昨日早晨发生在法租界的刺杀案可能是由该法庭的员工所为。

窦先生于上午11时40分左右在距离杜古特神父路（Rue Pere Dugout）约100码的天祥里（Tien Ziang Li）行走时被枪杀，当场毙命，他是昨日早晨在租界内被谋杀的第二名官员。另一起刺杀案发生在早晨八点左右，地点位于亨利路145号外，受害者是新市政府市公安局侦探高洪兆（Kao Hong-tsao）。他头部中四弹，倒地身亡。

尽管某些圈子提出一种理论，认为南区地方法院院长的遇害是一种报复行为——该机构原定于农历新年开业——但更普遍的看法是，这两起策划周密且执行完美的谋杀案具有政治性质，很可能是同一伙政治恐怖分子所为，这伙人最近在越界筑路地区和公共租界制造了恐怖统治。

昨日两起刺杀案后无人被捕，尽管两起谋杀均发生在光天化日之下，但法国警察只能找到水上警察侦探谋杀案的目击者。在该案中，一名中国妇女被跳弹击伤腿部。

法院员工的投诉

据报道，周二，窦先生指示鉴于农历新年假期临近，向南區地方法院的所有员工，包括狱卒和苦力，发放薪水。有些人获得了一个月的薪水，有些人获得了20天的工资，还有些人获得了半个月的工资。然而，每个人的工资袋中都扣除了六美元，作为供应给他们的食物费用。员工们提出抗议，称在过去45天里，他们在值班期间吃的唯一食物是他们从家里带来或自己购买的食物。

随后发生了一场小规模骚乱，愤怒的员工袭击并殴打了窦先生，报道如是说。在其他几位官员的帮助下，窦先生设法从愤怒员工的控制中逃脱。最终，整个事件由法庭秘书沈敬祖（Hsen Ching-tsu，音译）平息。

pages.en:
01734

Walking Alone
It is on these grounds that the
theory was advanced that Mr. Dou
may have been murdered by his own
subordinates, out of revenge. The
52-year-old lawyer, was walking in
Tien Ziang Li, near Rue Pere Dug-
out, at about 11.40 a.m., when he
was apparently accosted by one or
more gunmen and shot twice be-
tween the eyes. There were no eye-
witnesses to the brutal killing.
Police were attracted to the scene
by the sound of the shots and when
they arrived Mr. Dou was already
dead. Nevertheless, he was convey-
ed in an ambulance to St. Marie's
Hospital, where life was pronounced
extinct.
Kao, the River Police detective,
was earlier attacked not far from
the spot where Mr. Dou was killed.
Kao, who lived at 25 Teng Zeng Li,
was walking along Rue Hennequin,
when outside No. 145, he was sud-
denly stopped by two men, one of,
whom drew out a pistol, stepped a
few yards away from Kao and then
fired four shots at the victim. The
detective collapsed dead, passers-by
fled for cover, while a young Chinese
woman received, a flesh wound in
the leg from one of the bullets,
which went straight through the de-
tective's head and ricocheted off a
wall.
Rumour Denied
Rumours were current in Shanghai
yesterday to the effect that two
Japanese soldiers had been shot,
presumably fatally, in the Yangtze-
poo district in the morning. Asked
about this at the afternoon press con-
ference, the spokesmen said:—
“No that is not true. The report
is entirely unfounded.”
pages.zh:
01734

独自步行
正是基于这些理由，有人提出窦先生可能被其下属出于报复而谋杀的理论。这位52岁的律师于上午11时40分左右在杜古特神父路（Rue Pere Dugout）附近的天祥里（Tien Ziang Li）行走时，显然被一名或多名枪手拦住，并在双眼之间连中两枪。这起残忍的杀戮没有目击者。

警察被枪声吸引到现场，当他们到达时，窦先生已经死亡。尽管如此，他还是被救护车送往圣玛丽医院（St. Marie's Hospital），在那里被宣布死亡。

水上警察侦探高某早些时候在距离窦先生遇害地点不远的地方遭到袭击。居住在滕增里25号（Teng Zeng Li）的高某正沿着亨利路（Rue Hennequin）行走，当走到145号外时，突然被两名男子拦住，其中一人拔出手枪，退后几码，然后向受害者开了四枪。侦探倒地身亡，路人纷纷躲避，而一名年轻中国妇女的腿部受皮肉伤，这是因为其中一颗子弹直接穿过了侦探的头部并从墙壁反弹所致。

谣言被否认

昨日上海流传着谣言，称两名日本士兵早晨在杨树浦地区被枪击，据推测已致命。在下午的新闻发布会上被问及此事时，发言人表示：“不，那不是真的。该报道完全毫无根据。”

pages.en:
NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.
01774
FEB 1 7 1939

Nantao Court Chief, Policeman
Killed in French Concession

Both Weapons Identified as Having Been Used
On July 7, 1938 in Separate Shooting Affrays

ASSASSINS in the French Concession, struck quickly and effec-
tively on two occasions within four hours yesterday morning,
killing Dou Tseng-kao, recently appointed president of the Nantao
District Court, and Kao Hing-tsao, constable of the "Ta Tao" river
police. In both cases, death was instantaneous.

When Dou Tseng-kao, alias Douh Foh, 52 year-old native of
Soochow, one-time lawyer and for the last two months the presi-
dent of the Nantao District Court, was proceeding along Tien
Siang alleyway off Rue Pere Dugout at 11.40 a.m., an undetermined
number of men stopped him and fired two shots—both fatal—
hitting him square between the eyes. The victim sank to the
ground and a policeman who was on duty near by, arrived on the
scene a few seconds later only to find that the assassins had de-
camped. There was no actual witness to the shooting, the only
person so far questioned by the police having been a male-servant
working in a near by kitchen, who said that he heard two shots fired.

As far as could be ascertained last
night, however, the French police
have a clue, inasmuch as that from
the cartridge cases picked up at the
scene of the assassination, it was
established that the pistol used was
the same as that which ended the life
of Mr. Kozaburo Kano, a Japanese
engineer employed by the N. K. W.
No. 1 Cotton Mill, who was killed on
the morning of July 7, 1938, as he was
riding to work on his bicycle along
Robison Road.

Dou, upon his appointment to his
present position, decided to house the
court in the premises of a primary
school in Nantao, as the actual court
buildings had been destroyed during
hostilities. The court was actually
supposed to commence functioning at
the beginning of this year but, as will
be remembered, the opening had to
be postponed because no suitable pres-
ident could be found. An insignificant
number of cases were reported to have
been tried in the Nantao court since
it commenced functioning.

Dou's residence at house 24 Hong
Tching Alleyway off Rue Amiral
Baille, was searched by French de-
tectives yesterday, and persons who
had been in close contact with the
deceased, were questioned but inves-
tigations so far have revealed little
and are still being continued.

Policeman Killed

The other shooting occurred shortly
after 8 a.m., when Kao Hing-tsao, 36
year-old constable of the "Ta Tao"
river police, was shot and fatally in-
jured opposite 145 Rue Hennequin,
near the West Gate to Nantao.

The victim had just left his home
at house number 25 Teng Zeng Lane,
off Rue Hennequin, when two men
approached him and one of them
brandished a pistol, firing four shots,
all of which were mortal, hitting the
victim in the head. The two terrorists
then made their escape through the
throng which filled the street at the
time.
pages.zh:
《华北每日新闻》（NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS）。
01774
1939年2月17日

南市法院主管、警察
在法租界遇害

两件凶器均被确认曾用于
1938年7月7日的单独枪击事件

法租界的刺客昨日早晨在四小时内迅速而有效地实施了两次袭击，杀害了最近任命的南区地方法院院长窦曾皋（Dou Tseng-kao）和“大盗”水上警察警员高兴兆（Kao Hing-tsao）。在两起案件中，死亡均为瞬间发生。

当窦曾皋（又名Douh Foh），52岁，苏州人，前律师，过去两个月担任南区地方法院院长，于上午11时40分沿杜古特神父路（Rue Pere Dugout）旁的天祥巷（Tien Siang alleyway）前行时，数量不明的人拦住了他，并开了两枪——均致命——正中其双眼之间。受害者倒在地上，附近执勤的一名警察几秒钟后赶到现场，却发现刺客已逃之夭夭。枪击案没有实际目击者，警方目前询问的唯一人员是一名在附近厨房工作的男仆，他说他听到了两声枪响。

然而，据昨晚查明，法国警察掌握了一条线索，因为从刺杀现场捡到的弹壳来看，已确定使用的手枪与结束日籍工程师加纳小三郎（Kozaburo Kano）生命的手枪相同。加纳受雇于内外棉第一厂（N. K. W. No. 1 Cotton Mill），于1938年7月7日早晨骑自行车沿罗宾森路（Robison Road）上班途中被杀。

窦上任现职后，决定将法院设在南市一所小学的校舍内，因为实际的法院建筑已在战事中被毁。法院实际上本应于今年年初开始运作，但正如人们所记得的那样，由于找不到合适的院长，开幕式不得不推迟。自开始运作以来，据报道仅有少量案件在南市法院进行了审理。

昨日，法国侦探搜查了窦位于白利南路（Rue Amiral Baille）旁宏庆里24号的住所，并讯问了与死者有密切接触的人员，但目前的调查收效甚微，仍在继续进行中。

警察遇害

另一起枪击案发生在上午8点后不久，当时“大盗”水上警察局36岁的警员高兴兆（Kao Hing-tsao）在靠近南市西门的亨利路145号对面被枪击并受致命伤。

受害者刚离开位于亨利路旁滕增里25号的家中，两名男子便向他走近，其中一人挥舞着手枪，开了四枪，全部致命，击中受害者头部。随后，两名恐怖分子穿过当时挤满街道的人群逃离现场。

pages.en:
01775

Woman Injured
One of the bullets, after having
struck a wall, ricocheted and slightly
injured a Chinese woman, named
Wang Li-ze, in the right leg. She was
treated in hospital and was permitted
to go to her home, however.
Kao, investigations revealed, was a
constable in the "Tao Tao" river
police, operating outside the city
limits of Shanghai and had been in
the employ of that organization for
quite some time. Nothing, according
to investigating police officials, re-
vealed that the murder was of a
political nature, inasmuch as that the
only document found on Kao's body
was a private letter and a subsequent
search of his home revealed no evi-
dence to the effect that he had ever
been threatened. His wife, closely
questioned at the police station, also
denied that her husband had ever
been threatened and it is for this
reason that the French police are in-
clined to believe that the man was
murdered for personal vengeance
rather than on a political count.
The attack was made so suddenly
that constables on duty near by were
unable to take up the chase.
Subsequent examination by ballistic
experts of the cartridge cases found
at the scene, revealed however that
this weapon too, had been used in one
of the many shooting affrays that kept
Shanghai under terror on July 7, 1938,
first anniversary of the Loukouchiao
Incident, when bombs were thrown
and many persons killed and injured
in the worst day of terrorism to which
Shanghai had been exposed in history.
The last political murder, in the
French Concession, was committed on
September 30, when Mr. Tong Shao-
yi, the first Prime Minister of the
Republic of China in 1912, was
brutally axed to death in his home
at 18 Route Ferguson, by a band of
men who had entered the Tong re-
sidence under the pretext of bringing
wedding presents for the former
statesman's daughter. They left the
house calmly, once their crime was
perpetrated, and it was only later
discovered that Mr. Teng had been
the victim of assassins. Although not
an active member of the "Reformed
Government," it was hinted at the
time that the veteran politician had
been approached to take up an im-
portant position with the new régime.
pages.zh:
01775

女子受伤
其中一颗子弹击中墙壁后反弹，轻微击伤了一名名叫王丽泽（Wang Li-ze，音译）的中国女子的右腿。她在医院接受了治疗，但随后被允许回家。
调查显示，高某（Kao）是“涛涛”水上警察队的一名巡捕，该部队在上海市区范围外活动，他受雇于该组织已有相当长的一段时间。据负责调查的警务官员称，没有任何迹象表明这起谋杀具有政治性质，因为在高某身上发现的唯一文件是一封私人信件，随后对其住所的搜查也未发现他曾受到威胁的证据。他的妻子在警察局接受严密讯问时，也否认其丈夫曾受到威胁，因此法国警方倾向于相信此人是因为个人仇怨而非政治原因被谋杀。
袭击发生得如此突然，以至于附近执勤的巡捕无法展开追捕。
然而，弹道专家对现场发现的弹壳进行的后续检查显示，这把武器也曾用于1938年7月7日——即卢沟桥事变一周年纪念日——上海发生的众多枪战事件之一，当时炸弹横飞，许多人死伤，那是上海历史上遭受恐怖主义最严重的一天。
法租界内最近一起政治谋杀案发生在9月30日，中华民国首任总理唐绍仪先生在其费伦路18号（Route Ferguson）的家中被一伙人残忍地用斧头砍死，这伙人以给这位前政治家的女儿送结婚礼物为借口进入了唐宅。罪行实施后，他们从容地离开了房子，直到后来才发现唐先生成了刺客的受害者。虽然唐先生并非“维新政府”的活跃成员，但当时有暗示称，这位资深政治家曾被接洽，要在新政权中担任重要职务。

pages.en:
Ta Ying Yeh Pao (31/1) :-

THE SHANGHAI DISTRICT COURT AT NANTAO

The sum of $3,000 issued for the establishment
of the Shanghai District Court at Nantao has already
been spent. No further funds have been received from
the Nanking regime, therefore, the employees of the
Court are asking Tu (唐), the President, for their wages.
It is probable that the Court will be
dissolved next month owing to financial difficulties
and lack of cases.
pages.zh:
大英夜报 (31/1) :-

南市上海地方法院

用于建立南市上海地方法院的3,000美元款项已经花光。南京方面未再拨付资金，因此，法院员工正向院长唐（Tu）索要工资。
由于财政困难和案件匮乏，该法院下个月可能会解散。

pages.en:
FM. 2
G. 55M

Subject Shanghai City District Court - Present situation

Made by I. Fan Lien Lih Forwarded by

Ever since the assumption of office by Mr. Doo
Tseng-kao (屠 振鵠), alias Doo Fu (屠 復), as
President of the Shanghai City District Court, City, on
January 1, 1939 when the court was formally inaugurated,
practically no cases have thus far been brought to this
institution. All cases in the hands of the Police
Bureau being still taken to and arraigned before the Bureau
of Justice, a judicial organ responsible to the Shanghai
City Government, in Pootung.

On several occasions, meetings have been held
between Mr. Doo Tseng-kao and Mr. Woo Wen-tscong (吳文中),
Commissioner of the Bureau of Social Affairs of the Shanghai
City Government and discussions have taken place with a view
to cooperation between the two departments and possible
amalgamation, but due to the obdurate stand taken by Mr. Fu
Siao-an (傅筱), Mayor of the Shanghai City Government,
no tangible results have so far been achieved.

It is learned that the firm refusal of Mayor Fu
Siao-an to entertain any idea of cooperation with the newly-
established law court, is based on the fact that Doo Tseng-
kao in obtaining the post as President of the Shanghai City
District Court agreed to pay a sum of $10,000 monthly to
the Reformed Government in Nanking. Apart from the fore-
going financial obligation, Doo Tseng-kao has also to bear
the expenses incurred in his administration. It is feared
that in order to meet his many obligations, Doo Tseng-kao
might endeavour to make capital out of justice, and in
consequence, Mayor Fu Siao-an resolutely refuses to extend

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS.
JAN 1 1 1939

Nantao Court Created:
Cannot Function

Control Dispute Between
Japanese and Nanking

The Nantao District Court, a tribunal which aims at dealing with all Chinese criminal and civil cases in the occupied areas in Shanghai has already come into existence in Nantao under the supervision of the "Reformed Government" at Nanking but it cannot function well on account of an alleged dispute between the Japanese Special Service Section claiming its control and the new Nanking regime, state Chinese reports.

It is stated that the Judicial Department of the new Greater Shanghai City Government wanted to establish the court long ago but it failed to do so. The Ministry of Justice in Nanking therefore appointed Mr. Tu Fu, a Shanghai lawyer, to be the chief judge of the Nantao District Court. A former school site in Pong Lai Road, Nantao was chosen for the court which was recently inaugurated.

On the ground that the Nanking officials had not obtained permission beforehand, officials of the Special Service Section stopped the operations of the new court allowing it, however, to open its doors pending new arrangements. Mr. Hu Chi-tai, Minister of Justice at Nanking, has referred the dispute to Mayor Fu Hsiao-en of the Shanghai City Government, and the latter is said to be making overtures.

So far, no official petition papers usually brought by parties to a legal dispute have been issued by the new court, and consequently no hearings have been held.

字林西报。
1939年1月11日

成立南市法院：
无法运作

日本与南京之间的控制权争端

据中文报道，旨在处理上海占领区内所有中国刑事和民事案件的南市地方法院，已在南京“维新政府”的监督下于南市成立，但由于日本特务机关声称拥有控制权与新的南京政权之间据称存在争端，该法院无法正常运作。

据悉，新的上海特别市政府司法部早就希望建立该法院，但未能成功。因此，南京司法部任命上海律师屠复（Tu Fu）先生为南市地方法院首席法官。法院选址于南市蓬莱路的一处原校址，并于近期举行了就职典礼。

以南京官员事先未获得许可为由，特务机关官员停止了新法院的运作，但允许其在等待新安排期间开门。南京司法部长胡继泰（Hu Chi-tai，音译）已将此争端提交给上海市政府市长傅筱恩（Fu Hsiao-en，即傅筱庵），据说后者正在进行斡旋。

到目前为止，新法院尚未签发通常由法律纠纷当事人提交的正式诉状，因此也未举行任何听证会。

S. B. REGISTRY

Subject Chen Kuo Chai appointed Chief of the Judicial Department
of the Shanghai City Government.
Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao Liang

Enquiries confirm that Chen Kuo Chai (陳國才)
has been appointed Chief of the Judicial Department of the
Shanghai City Government.
Chen Kuo Chai alias Chen Kan Kung (陳幹公) is
a native of Nanhai Hsien, Kwangtung Province, age about 40.
He has resided at 58 Tungchow Road since 1931.
He was registered as a member of the Bar
Association of Shanghai in August 1931 and has practised
as a lawyer ever since.
The appointment was made by Mayor Fu Siao-en
as a counter measure to the proposed formation of a Chinese
Court at Nantao by Chen Fu Ming (陳福民), brother of the
Kiangsu Civil Governor Chen Cheh Ling and new President of the
Kiangsu High Court. Chen Fu Ling has already appointed
many judges in districts under Japanese control.
It will be seen that the above Judicial Department
will be independent of the Ministry of Justice of the Reformed
Government and its functioning may lead to internal strife
amongst the puppet officials.

Superintendents P.O.A.

查询证实，陈国才（Chen Kuo Chai，陳國才）已被任命为上海市政府司法部部长。
陈国才，别名陈干公（Chen Kan Kung，陳幹公），广东省南海县人，年龄约40岁。自1931年以来一直居住在通州路58号。
他于1931年8月注册成为上海律师公会会员，并自此从事律师职业。
此项任命是傅筱恩（Fu Siao-en，即傅筱庵）市长针对由江苏省民政厅长陈则民（Chen Cheh Ling）之兄、新任江苏高等法院院长陈福民（Chen Fu Ming）提议在南市设立中国法院而采取的对策。陈福民（原文此处误写为Chen Fu Ling，应指陈福民）已在日军控制下的各区任命了许多法官。
由此可见，上述司法部将独立于维新政府司法部，其运作可能导致伪官员内部的内部斗争。

Shun Pao :-

THE NEW NANTAO DISTRICT COURT

The signboard of the Shanghai District Court
was displayed early this month in front of the Si Chen
Primary School ( 西成小学 ), Boon Lai Road, Nantao.
Tu Tseng-kuo ( 屠增國 ), the President of the Court,
two Judges and some 20 coolies are living on the premises.
The Court lacks funds. The food and other expenses
of the Court are advanced by Tu. The Judges and coolies
receive no wages. No funds have been issued by the
Ministry of Justice of the "Reformed Government".
pages.zh:
《申报》：

新的南市区法院

本月早些时候，南市蓬莱路西成小学门前挂出了上海地方法院的招牌。
法院院长屠增国、两名法官以及约20名苦力住在该处。
法院缺乏资金。法院的伙食及其他费用由屠氏垫付。法官和苦力均无薪俸。“维新政府”司法部未拨付任何款项。

Morning Leader and other local newspapers :-
COURT TO BE ESTABLISHED IN NANTAO
Yesterday the Judicial Office in Pootung
was busily engaged sorting out documents preparatory
to removing to Nantao where a Court will be established.
It is learned that the inauguration of the
Court, which was originally fixed to take place on
January 1 next year, will be postponed to a later date
because the premises are not yet ready.
Tu Foh (屠佛), the President of the Court,
has already decided to appoint a number of his favourite
followers to positions with the Court. Thus the old
staff of the Judicial Office may be discharged.
pages.zh:
《导报》及其他本地报纸：
将在南市设立法院
昨日，浦东司法办事处正忙于整理文件，准备迁往南市，那里将设立一家法院。
据悉，原定于明年1月1日举行的法院成立典礼，因场所尚未就绪，将推迟至稍后日期举行。
法院院长屠佛已决定任命其多名亲信追随者在法院任职。因此，司法办事处的旧职员可能会被解雇。

pages.en:
Standard (Evening Edition) dated December 21 and other
local newspapers :-

SHANGHAI SPECIAL MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT ESTABLISHES
A COURT

According to information from judicial
circles, the Shanghai Special Municipal Government
has established a Court to deal with civil and criminal
cases. This Court has nothing to do with the judicial
organs of the "Reformed Government." It is an independent
body, because there are no Courts to hear appeals from
this Court. Mention is made that if a party is
dissatisfied with a judgment, he may, within ten days
of receipt of same, file an appeal. Judgments will
bear the chops of the President, the Sectional Chief
and the Judge. The name of the Judge is Chen Kuo-tsai
(陳國才).

12月21日出版的《标准晚报》及其他本地报纸：

上海特别市政府设立法院

据司法界消息，上海特别市政府已设立一家法院，以处理民事和刑事案件。该法院与“维新政府”的司法机关无关。它是一个独立机构，因为没有法院受理对该法院判决的上诉。据报道，如果当事人对判决不服，可在收到判决书之日起十日内提出上诉。判决书上将加盖院长、科长和法官的印章。法官姓名为陈国才。

Chinese-American Daily News :-

MAYOR FU TO ESTABLISH A DISTRICT COUNCIL

Wang Zung-tsung (王長春), a councillor
of the Shanghai Special Municipal Government, has
suggested to Mayor Fu Siao-en (傅筱庵) that the
administration be conducted along the lines of the former
Shanghai City Government. Fu Siao-en has approved the
idea.

A District Council, a zoo, a Peoples'
Educational Institute, a Library, etc., will be
established. It is learned that a sum of $500,000 has
been earmarked for the expenses. Sheng Siao-yu (盛小愚)
will be the Chairman of the District Council.

The Japanese Special Service Section
is insisting that the two Vice-Chairmen of the Council
be filled by Japanese, but Mayor Fu is strongly opposed
to it.

傅市长将设立区议会

上海特别市政府参事王长春向傅筱庵市长建议，行政管理工作应沿袭前上海市政府的模式进行。傅筱庵已批准该建议。

Sir,
At 2.30 p.m. 8-12-38, Mr. James Tsao (曹瑩) lawyer, living No.11 Dao Dah Lee (道達里) Avenue Road, telephone 34631, representing a Japanese named Mr. Hamada, living at 431 Boone Road, came to the Station (Louza) with a warrant of arrest, issued by the Nantao Court (Japanese sponsored) on 26-11-38 for the arrest of one Yang Sih Kwei (楊珪) on a charge of fraud by issuing a false cheque to the value of $1,926.00.
Warrant not endorsed by First Area Special District Court, sent to Mr. Tsao by post from Nantao Court.
Yang Sih Kwei (楊翊珪) stated to be living at Amoy Road, the assistance of a friend of Mr. Hamada being required to locate this man.
Mr. Tsao informed that this warrant of arrest, not having any endorsement by S.S.D. Court, S.M. Police were not able to assist in the execution of said warrant.
This warrant of arrest, receipt of which is attached, practically similar to warrant is forwarded for information (Mr. Tsao requests that this should be returned to him).
The man, Yang Sih Kwei (楊翊珪) named on this warrant of arrest is believed to be the same man, who is at present released on $5,000.00 security, charged from Louza Station on 19-8-38 with receiving stolen property, consisting of piece goods the property of the Wing On Textile Manufacturing Co. (永安紡織公司) for which he was convicted and sentenced to one year and six months imprisonment and fined $1,000.00 or six months labour for buying stolen property, this judgment being confirmed on Appeal by Yang Sih Kwei (楊翊) on 28-10-38. (F.I.R.2787/38 Louza).

先生，
1938年12月8日下午2时30分，住在爱文义路道达里11号、电话34631的律师曹瑩（James Tsao）先生，代表住在布恩路431号的日本人滨田（Hamada）先生，携带一张由南市法院（日本扶持）于1938年11月26日签发的逮捕令来到老闸捕房，要求逮捕杨珪（Yang Sih Kwei），指控其开具面值为1,926.00元的空头支票进行诈骗。
该逮捕令未经第一特区地方法院背书，由南市法院通过邮寄方式发送给曹先生。
杨翊珪（Yang Sih Kwei）据称住在厦门路，需要滨田先生的一位朋友协助才能找到此人。
曹先生被告知，由于该逮捕令没有特区地方法院的背书，上海公共租界警务处无法协助执行该逮捕令。
随函附上已收到的该逮捕令收据，该逮捕令实际上与所附逮捕令相似，供参考（曹先生要求将此件退还给他）。
该逮捕令上列名的杨翊珪（Yang Sih Kwei）被认为与同一人系同一人，此人目前以5,000.00元保释获释，曾于1938年8月19日在老闸捕房被控收受赃物，赃物为永安纺织公司的匹头布料，他因此被判犯有购买赃物罪，判处一年六个月监禁，并处罚金1,000.00元或服劳役六个月，该判决经杨翊（Yang Sih Kwei）于1938年10月28日上诉后维持原判。（F.I.R.2787/38 老闸）。

NEW SHANGHAI DISTRICT COURT TO BE INAUGURATED JANUARY :
As the buildings of the Shanghai District

SHANGHAI TIMES,

NOV 18 1938

EXTRA-AREA COURT
TO OPEN TO-DAY

First Case To Be Heard
By Judge Appointed By
Reformed Government

The Judicial Department of the newly formed Greater Shanghai Municipal Government in Kiang-wan, the status of which is somewhat similar to the former Nantao District Court, which tried criminals established in Chinese territory, will hear its first case to-day, it was reliably learnt last night from Chinese sources.

The chief judge of the new Chinese tribunal is Mr. Chang Pang-nien, a local Chinese lawyer, who was recently appointed to his present post by Mayor Fu Siao-en of the city regime.

Mr. Chang yesterday issued summons on a man named Yih Yen-chuan, who lives in the extra-Settlement road area near Robison Road, requiring his presence today in the new court, as he has been sued by a relative, Yih Chang-fu, for his alleged monopoly of use of a common property belonging to the whole family. It is alleged in the petition sent by the plaintiff that the defendant even planned to commit a murder in order to have things go his way.

The creation of a judicial system by the new local Chinese regime established under the supervision of the Japanese is an important development since the withdrawal of Chinese troops and Kuomintang officials from Shanghai. The former Poctung city regime never tried to revive the Nantao District Court, while efforts made by the "Reformed Government" to take over Chinese courts in the Settlement have been futile. Numerous criminals in Chinese territory here have gone unpunished.

1938年11月18日

越界筑路区法院
今日开庭

首案将由
维新政府任命之法官审理

据昨晚从华人方面可靠获悉，位于江湾的新成立的上海特别市政府司法部，其地位类似于前南市地方法院（该法院曾审理在中国领土内设立的刑事案件），将于今日审理其第一起案件。

新设中国法庭的首席法官是张邦年先生，他是一位本地华人律师，近期被该市政权市长傅筱庵任命现职。

张先生昨日向一名名叫叶延全的男子发出传票，该男子居住在罗便臣道附近的越界筑路区，要求其今日出庭受审，因其亲属叶章富指控其垄断使用属于全家族的共有财产。原告提交的诉状中称，被告甚至策划谋杀以遂其愿。

在日本人监督下建立的新地方华人社团政权创建司法体系，是自中国军队和国民党官员撤离上海以来的重要进展。前浦东市政权从未试图恢复南市地方法院，而“维新政府”接管租界内中国法院的努力也徒劳无功。此地中国领土内的众多罪犯一直未受惩处。

To Ying Yoh Pao (23/11) and other local newspapers :-

THE SHANGHAI DISTRICT COURT

The Ministry of Justice of the "Reformed
Government" has appointed Tu Chang-kuo ( 屠正國 ) as
President of the Shanghai District Court. Before he could
resume his post, the Court premises were set on fire
by guerrillas.
A Preparatory Office of the Shanghai
District Court has now been established in Thorne Road.
It is reported that the Si Chen Primary School ( 四成小學 )
on Boon Lei Road ( 蓬萊路 ), Nantao, may be used by the
Court. This school is now occupied by the Japanese
Pacification Section. Owing to the fact that he has
received several letters of warning, Tu Cheng-kuo is
reported to have resigned.
Another report states that the Shanghai
District Court will be inaugurated next month.

致《英耀报》（11月23日）及其他本地报纸：

上海地方法院

“维新政府”司法部已任命屠正国为上海地方法院院长。在他就职之前，法院办公场所被游击队纵火焚烧。
目前已在汤姆生路设立了上海地方法院筹备处。
据悉，南市蓬莱路的四成小学可能被法院使用。该校现被日本安抚部占用。据报道，由于收到数封警告信，屠正国已辞职。
另有消息称，上海地方法院将于下月正式成立。
